German Producer Inflation Hits Over 3-Year High — Germany’s producer prices advanced 4.6% year-on-year in August 2026, marking the fifth straight month of producer price growth and accelerating from July’s reading of 3.0% and surpassing market forecasts of 4.1%. It was the fastest increase in producer prices since April 2023, mainly boosted by rises in energy prices (8.3% vs 3.8%). Meanwhile, prices for intermediate goods accelerated to 6.1% from 5.4% in July. Excluding energy, producer prices rose 3.1%. 【特斯拉被曝啟動機器人量產審廠，多家供應鏈企業回應】近日有訊息稱，特斯拉相關團隊已於9月16日落地寧波，並於9月17日開啟新一輪針對旗下機器人業務的量產審廠；特斯拉此輪審廠將實質導向機器人Optimus的量產，目前已經向供應鏈企業下達相關訂單。另有訊息稱，去年9月特斯拉在華曾啟動一輪機器人審廠工作，涉及的公司包括拓普集團、三花智控、浙江榮泰、新泉股份、均勝電子等傳統特斯拉汽車供應鏈企業。9月18日，特斯拉未回應相關情況。記者還以投資者身份致電總部位於寧波的拓普集團、均勝電子等公司詢問相關情況。拓普集團接電工作人員回覆稱，暫時沒有接到特斯拉團隊審廠的相關通知。均勝電子接電工作人員表示，因有保密性要求，涉及到下游客戶不方便回應。三花智控工作人員回覆稱，不清楚特斯拉新一輪審廠的情況。（第一財經）

New Zealand Stocks End Week 1.1% Higher — The NZX 50 lost 17 points, or 0.1%, to close at 13,739 on Friday, reversing its morning gains and halting a two-session winning streak, as traders continued to assess the GDP data. Thursday’s data showed New Zealand’s GDP eased to 0.1% quarterly from 0.2%. Traders anticipated China’s interest rate decision and US PMI data next week for clues about the economic outlook in the two countries. However, the latest data capped gains, as New Zealand’s trade deficit narrowed in August from July, while food inflation stayed at a 19-month low. A rally on Wall Street Thursday also helped prevent the index from falling deeper, as easing oil prices softened Treasury yields. Consumer staples, financials, and communication services mainly weighed on the index, with the biggest laggards including A2 Milk (-3.9%), Skellerup Holdings (-2.9%), Gentrack Group (-2.6%), Infratil (-1.0%), and Westpac Banking Corp (-0.9%). For the week, the index rose 1.1%, after falling in the previous week.

【上交所對ST中路及有關責任人予以通報批評，對其關聯方及責任人監管警示】9月17日，上海證券交易所釋出《關於對中路股份有限公司關聯方及有關責任人予以監管警示的決定》和《關於對中路股份有限公司及其實際控制人陳榮、控股股東上海中路（集團）有限公司和有關責任人予以通報批評的決定》。經查明，中路股份有限公司、實際控制人陳榮、控股股東上海中路（集團）有限公司在資訊披露、規範運作方面，有關責任人在職責履行方面，存在如下違規行為。中路優勢（天津）股權投資基金合夥企業（有限合夥）是中路股份出資99%並控股的企業。陳榮是中路股份、中路集團、上海中路投資管理中心（有限合夥）和上海機商實業有限公司的實際控制人。2024年2月至2025年6月，陳榮、中路集團、中路投資和上海機商等關聯方，透過中路優勢對外投資、支付諮詢顧問費等方式非經營性佔用上市公司資金1248萬元。公司未審議、未及時披露上述關聯方非經營性資金佔用構成的關聯交易事項，也未在2024年半年度報告、2024年年度報告和2025年半年度報告中披露上述關聯方非經營性佔用資金情況。2025年6月5日，公司披露《關於對上海證券交易所監管工作函的回覆公告》，其中明確公司2024年度前十大客戶、前十大供應商的名稱、交易金額、交易內容等具體情況，同時披露未發現公司2024年度主要客戶與供應商之間存在其他關聯關係或潛在利益安排，主要客戶及主要供應商與公司發生的交易具有商業實質。公司《回覆公告》中披露的部分客戶與供應商的關係、交易金額等與實際情況不符，資訊披露不準確。上交所決定，對中路股份有限公司關聯方上海中路投資管理中心（有限合夥）、上海機商實業有限公司、時任董事會秘書朱智予以監管警示。對中路股份有限公司及其實際控制人陳榮，控股股東上海中路（集團）有限公司，時任董事長、總經理陳閃予以通報批評。

【賽力斯回應合作新模式會否影響問界“含華量”：華為終端持續參與賦能】今日，對於新合作模式下華為賦能意味著什麼以及會不會影響問界的“含華量”問題，賽力斯集團董事、副總裁康波回應：問界由華為與賽力斯聯合設計打造，也是跨界融合與產業升級的重要成果。賽力斯與華為堅定在一起、造好車，問界仍然是鴻蒙智行大家庭的核心成員之一，華為終端持續參與賦能。同時，賽力斯也是深圳引望公司的股東，持股比例達10%，引望聚合了華為智慧車業務的眾多核心技術。作為股東方，問界將有華為最新、最好、最實用的技術、產品以及供應保障。

【吉林省委常委、常務副省長蔡東調任國家金融監督管理總局黨委委員】近日，國家金融監督管理總局官網“總局領導”欄目更新資訊顯示，蔡東已經擔任國家金融監督管理總局黨委委員。蔡東，男，漢族，1968年10月生，中共黨員，研究生學歷，經濟學博士學位。蔡東長期在金融系統工作，曾任中國工商銀行電子銀行部總經理，天津市分行行長、黨委書記，國家開發銀行副行長、黨委委員，中國農業銀行執行董事、副行長、黨委委員等職，2019年10月出任吉林省政府黨組成員、副省長。2022年6月，蔡東出任吉林省委常委、常務副省長。（澎湃新聞）

【馬來西亞前總理納吉布將以居家監禁形式繼續服刑】當地時間9月18日，馬來西亞特赦局宣佈，允許馬前總理納吉布以居家監禁的方式服役完剩餘刑期，至2028年8月。納吉布2009年至2018年擔任馬來西亞總理。他上任後設立名為“一個馬來西亞發展公司（一馬公司）”的主權投資基金。2020年7月，吉隆坡高等法院裁定，納吉布在“一馬公司”前子公司SRC國際公司案件中涉嫌挪用公款、洗錢等7項罪名成立，處以12年監禁和2.1億林吉特罰款。（央視新聞）

【神州數碼：旗下神州鯤泰推出基於昇騰950技術路線的新一代產品矩陣】9月17日，昇騰AI人工智慧產業峰會舉辦，現場昇騰950超節點正式上市。同期，神州數碼旗下神州鯤泰正式釋出基於昇騰950技術路線的新一代AI算力產品矩陣，涵蓋KunTai A989 I5標準伺服器、KunTai A989 I5風冷超節點、KunTai PoD2000 A5液冷超節點，精準適配大模型訓練、高併發智慧推理等核心AI業務場景，為各行業AI智慧化發展築牢高效能算力底座。其中，面向大規模資料中心建設、萬億級大模型訓練與中心高併發推理場景算力，KunTai PoD2000 A5單個超節點整合1024卡，支援256TB統一記憶體編址，千卡MTBF高達300小時，領先業界25%以上。依託TB級NPU互聯超大頻寬與3μs超低RTT時延，突破叢集內計算、儲存等各類資源的通訊瓶頸。

【中美外長這通電話釋放出的資訊】根據2026年5月美國總統特朗普訪華時的雙方共識，習近平主席將於今年秋季對美國進行國事訪問。值此之際，中共中央政治局委員、外交部長王毅9月17日同美國國務卿魯比奧通電話。 從中方通稿看，這通電話直接點明核心問題：雙方“著重就兩國高層交往進行了深入討論”，並就中東局勢等問題交換了意見。這實際上透露出當前中美關係幾個值得重視的動向：一是，中美正在為下一階段高層互動作準備；二是，雙方都需要避免關係失序；三是，臺灣問題雖然沒有出現在通稿文字中，卻依然是決定中美關係能否穩定前行的深層變數。 一通電話無法解決中美之間長期積累的結構性矛盾，但可以校準預期、劃明邊界、為新一輪高層會晤開啟溝通空間。對於中美這樣兩個大國而言，這種溝通本身是十分必要的。（環球時報）

【水滴籌服務費從6%上漲至8%，客服回應：系技術、運營及資金的持續投入所致】9月18日下午訊息，近日，有患者家屬反映，在水滴籌平臺籌款，提現時被提示要求收取8%提現金額的服務費以及0.6%提現金額的第三方支付通道費用，患者家屬申請提現6831元，被收取546.48元的服務費以及41.04元的第三方支付通道費，患者家屬質疑8%的服務費過高。對此，水滴籌客服告訴新浪財經，平臺在提供服務的過程中，持續在技術、運營和資金安全三大層面進行投入。“比如平臺開發並維護患者籌款，使用者捐款系統，組建醫學團隊、風控團隊等，以及搭建安全系統和模型並開設資金透明化通道等，這些層面的持續性投入是服務費漲價的原因。”客服表示，從今年8月15日開始發起的籌款，將收取8%的平臺服務費，此前收取金額為6%。

Palm Oil Retreats on Profit Taking But Heads for weekly gain — Malaysian palm oil futures hovered below MYR 4,910 per tonne, reversing recent gains as weakness in rival edible oils on Dalian and Chicago markets weighed on sentiment. Prices also pulled back from a 21-month high on profit-taking, while sluggish exports added pressure, with cargo surveyors estimating September 1–15 palm oil shipments fell between 17.8% and 25.6% from August. Crude oil also eased as extra cargoes tempered supply concerns, reducing palm’s biodiesel appeal. Even so, futures were still on track for a weekly gain of about 1.9%, supported by expectations of tighter supplies ahead. Indonesia’s B50 mandate is set to divert more palm oil to domestic use, while El Niño risks could curb output in both Indonesia and Malaysia. In India, imports rose 7% in August to 782,761 tonnes, the highest since February, as refiners replenished stocks ahead of the festival season. Separately, Malaysia raised its October crude palm oil reference price but kept the export duty unchanged at 10%.

【江蘇省出臺零碳園區建設實施方案 到2030年培育建成10個左右省級園區】江蘇省發展改革委、省工信廳近日聯合印發《江蘇省零碳園區建設實施方案》，同步啟動省級零碳園區組織申報。方案設定清晰發展目標：到2030年，全省培育建成10個左右省級零碳園區，園區綠色能源結構持續最佳化，綠色低碳產業體系基本形成，能碳管理能力顯著提升，形成一批可複製可推廣的經驗做法；到2035年，以園區為主陣地的零碳產業生態體系初步構建，產業國際綠色競爭力大幅躍升。

【美軍F-16戰機在密歇根州墜毀 附近居民一度被疏散 】據美國廣播公司17日報道，美國得克薩斯州空軍國民警衛隊一架F-16戰鬥機當天下午在密歇根州墜毀，飛行員彈射逃生。因危險化學品洩漏，周邊人員一度被疏散。報道援引得克薩斯州軍事部的宣告說，這架戰鬥機當時從附近訓練中心起飛，執行例行訓練任務，隨後“發生事故”。飛行員成功彈射逃生，目前正在附近一家醫院接受救治。當地政府說，這架戰機於美國東部時間約14時墜毀。密歇根州警方表示，事故未造成其他人員受傷。（新華社）

【奇瑞董事長尹同躍現身華為坂田基地，與餘承東會談】近日，有網友在華為坂田基地偶遇華為常務董事、終端BG董事長餘承東與奇瑞董事長尹同躍會面，引發關注。網傳的資訊顯示，奇瑞董事長尹同躍近日落地深圳，隨後直接來到華為坂田基地與餘承東會面，兩人邊走邊聊、一同步入大門。目前，奇瑞與華為終端雙方對此暫無回應。當前也正值賽力斯與華為終端合作模式調整的節點，問界由華為終端主導改為賽力斯主導。包括智界在內的另外四界接下來有何新動態，也備受市場關注。（新浪科技）
【江西贛州啟動突發地質災害四級應急響應】9月18日上午，江西贛州市應急指揮部發布通知：鑑於贛州市上猶縣五指峰鄉高峰村部附近發生地質災害險情，根據《贛州市突發地質災害應急預案》規定，決定於9月18日8時起啟動市級突發地質災害四級應急響應。受近期強降雨影響，9月18日凌晨，上猶縣五指峰鄉高峰村發生泥石流險情，造成4棟空置房屋倒塌，村內部分交通受阻，通訊暢通，無人員傷亡和失聯被困。（央視新聞）
【李在明說韓國不會向霍爾木茲海峽部署軍事力量】韓國總統李在明18日就向霍爾木茲海峽部署軍事力量的問題表態說，韓國不會派兵參與或介入伊朗戰事。 李在明當天在總統府青瓦臺召開記者會時作出上述表態。李在明說，韓國不會以任何形式派兵或者投送軍事資產，這是韓國一直堅守的原則，今後也不會改變這一原則。(新華社)

【四川3市將開展國家氫能綜合應用試點】從四川省經濟和資訊化廳獲悉，我國近日正式批覆5個城市群開展氫能綜合應用試點，新疆—成渝地區雙城經濟圈城市群獲批開展為期4年的試點建設。 其中，成都、德陽、攀枝花3市作為試點城市群的重要組成部分，重點承擔氫燃料電池汽車推廣、關鍵技術裝備攻關、創新領域應用等關鍵任務。當前，四川全省已形成以成都為核心，向攀枝花、德陽、南充等地輻射的協同發展格局，培育東方電氣、厚普股份等一批“鏈主”企業，帶動聚集產業鏈上下游企業及科研院所超100家。

【創新藥板塊迎利好 業績有望持續高增長股名單出爐】工業和資訊化部等十部門聯合釋出的《醫藥工業發展“十五五”規劃》（簡稱《規劃》）提出，到2030年，生物醫藥研發應用穩居世界前列，創新驅動效能充分釋放，重點領域關鍵核心技術實現系統性突破，生物醫藥產業加速成為國家新興支柱產業。展望下半年，平安醫藥精選基金經理周思聰認為創新藥有望成為重要成長主線。從資金面來看，本週以來，近30只創新藥概念股獲得融資客加倉，藥明康德、凱萊英、成都先導、美迪西的融資淨買入額居前。我武生物、華蘭生物、華納藥廠月內均獲得機構調研。結合機構預測來看，獲得10家及以上機構給予評級的概念股中，有15股2026年和2027年業績有望持續超10%幅度增長，包含藥明康德、恆瑞醫藥、凱萊英、康龍化成、科倫藥業等股。

【何小鵬：做機器人的難度相當於造車的近20倍】9月17日晚，小鵬集團董事長何小鵬在接受採訪時透露，機器人研發非常困難，做機器人的難度相當於造車的近20倍。“基本來講，我們的機器人的硬體、軟體、設計及供應鏈都是自己的。過去我一直不願意把機器人拿出來，主要是因為不能量產，市面上很多機器人能力演示都是透過剪輯之後放出來的。現在我們的機器人開始逐步量產，等到今年四季度、明年一季度和二季度，小鵬機器人的能力可能會有跨越。”何小鵬表示。此外，針對電池自研佈局，何小鵬表示：“從今年開始，電池都是我們自己做，但小鵬不做電芯。”（每經）

Sensex Gains as Oil Prices Ease — India’s BSE Sensex edged up about 0.2% to 74,435 on Friday, after the benchmark was largely muted in the previous session, as investors took some comfort from easing crude oil prices, while continued Middle East tensions and a rush of initial public offerings capped gains. Brent crude eased 0.9% to around $104 a barrel. Investors also remained focused on the National Stock Exchange’s roughly $2.3 billion initial public offering. Expected foreign inflows linked to the IPO could support the rupee, although the heavy IPO pipeline is also drawing liquidity away from the secondary market. Among stocks, Lodha (3.5%), Yatharth (6.6%), Netweb (1.6%), and Syrma SGS (3.6%) were among the notable gainers. Meanwhile, tech stocks remained in the red, led by Infosys (-1.2%), Tech Mahindra (-1.9%), Coforge (-1.2%), and Wipro (-1.1%). Tata group stocks were also among the notable decliners, with TCS, Tata Motors, Tata Investment Corporation, and Tata Chemicals falling between about 2.6% and 7.8%.

【智譜推出GLM-5.3-FlashX】9月18日，智譜正式推出GLM-5.3-FlashX（最高200 tokens/s）。GLM-5.3-FlashX API現已上線，Model Key：GLM-5.3-FlashX。據介紹，新版本推理速度最高可達200 tokens/s，較現有GLM-5.3-Flash提升5倍，定價提升至原版本的2.5倍。
【馬來西亞今年生物柴油消費量或增至140萬噸】馬來西亞生物柴油協會會長Tee Lip Teng表示，作為全球第二大棕櫚油生產國，馬來西亞今年生物柴油消費量預計可達140萬噸，高於去年的100萬噸。他週五在巴厘島一場生物燃料會議間隙稱，該國正在交通運輸領域推行B10至B20摻混計劃，工業領域則執行B7標準。他表示，馬來西亞需要升級儲罐設施，以支援更高比例的生物柴油摻混。

【大摩：維持李寧“增持”評級 目標價22.5港元】摩根士丹利釋出研報稱，維持李寧(02331)“增持”評級，目標價22.5港元。公司今年7月零售銷售錄高單位數或以上跌幅，但8月趨勢有所改善，其中線下跌幅收窄，線上銷售則受到直播活動所帶動。8月整體零售銷售同比相對穩定。公司認為目前評論9月趨勢仍為時尚早，但預期中秋節假期將支援9月表現。該行提到，李寧受行業競爭及特賣場銷售佔比提高影響，7月至8月的線下零售折扣有所加深，但這並非由庫存去化所驅動，公司此前已下調下半年訂單。

【斗山擬投資9700億韓元擴大AI晶片材料生產】9月18日，據報道，韓國斗山集團計劃投資9700億韓元，擴大AI半導體核心材料“覆銅板（CCL）”的生產。斗山計劃首先在韓國投資4200億韓元，擴建光模組用CCL生產線。該公司計劃在目前運營的全北益山金堤、忠北曾坪、慶北金泉工廠中，擴建其中一處的生產線。此外，斗山還將投資5500億韓元在中國再建一座用於AI加速器和網路交換機的CCL生產工廠。該公司計劃從2028年起提高韓國和中國擴建工廠的產量。
【日本首相高市早苗正在安排下週與美國總統特朗普會晤】媒體未說明訊息來源報道稱，日本首相高市早苗正在安排下週聯合國大會期間與美國總統特朗普會晤。另有媒體援引日美兩國未具名官員報道稱，正在安排於9月22日舉行會晤。

Malaysia Food Prices Rise the Most in 11 Months — Food prices in Malaysia rose 1.9% year-on-year in August 2026, up slightly from a 1.8% increase in the previous month and marking the fastest pace since September 2025. The food & beverages category accounts for 29.8% of the overall CPI basket, making it the largest component. Upward price pressures came from all components, including food consumed at home (1.4% vs 1.2% in July), cereals & cereal products (0.2% vs 0.2%), meat (3.5% vs 3.2%), fish & other seafood (0.9% vs 1.1%), milk, dairy products & eggs (1.5% vs 0.8%), oils & fats (0.1% vs 0.2%), fruits & nuts (1.4% vs 1.1%), vegetables (2.8% vs 1.0%), sugar, confectionery & desserts (0.5% vs 0.4% vs 0.5%), and food away from home (2.5% vs 2.5%).

【住建部：將加快推動城市更新立法】9月18日，國務院新聞辦公室舉行“開局起步‘十五五’”系列主題新聞釋出會，住房和城鄉建設部城市管理監督局局長張強在釋出會上表示，高質量推進城市更新，離不開政策機制保障。我們將著力推動建立健全4項機制：一是城市體檢與城市更新一體化推進機制，把體檢出來的問題作為城市更新的重點。二是城市更新規劃實施機制，建立從專項規劃到片區策劃，再到專案實施方案的實施體系。三是可持續的城市更新投融資機制，既加大政府投入力度，又更好地發揮市場力量作用。四是城市更新和歷史文化保護有機融合機制，讓歷史文化與現代生活相得益彰。同時，我們將加快推動城市更新立法，完善標準體系，為高質量推進城市更新工作夯實制度支撐。

Malaysia Inflation Inches Up to 1.9% in August — Malaysia’s annual inflation rate edged up to 1.9% in August 2026, above the 1.8% market forecast and July’s four-month low, while remaining comfortably within Bank Negara’s 1-1/2%-2-1/2% target range. Price growth accelerated for food and beverages (1.9% vs 1.8% in July), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (2.8% vs 2.7%), housing (2.1% vs 1.8%), furnishings and household equipment (0.4% vs 0.3%), health (1.3% vs 1.1%), transport (2.0% vs 1.4%), restaurants and accommodation services (2.1% vs 2.0%), and miscellaneous goods and services (3.2% vs 2.9%). In the meantime, clothing inflation was unchanged at 0.1%, while cost eased for information and communication (2.6% vs 3.4%), recreation and culture (1.1% vs 1.2%), education (1.9% vs 2.0%), and insurance and financial services (1.0% vs 1.1%). Core inflation fell to 1.7%, its lowest since December 2024, from 1.8% in July. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.3%, rebounding from July’s flat reading.

Malaysia August Export Growth Tops Forecasts — Malaysia’s exports surged 45.5% year-on-year to MYR 191.1 billion in August 2026, accelerating from a 38% growth in both July and market expectations. Growth was mainly boosted by higher shipments of manufactured goods, which climbed 50.4% and accounted for 89.5% of total exports, particularly in electrical and electronic products (66.5%). Exports of mining products also soared 43.3%, due to increased shipments of tin (180.6%), metalliferous ores and metal scrap (76.1%), and liquefied natural gas (51.8%). However, the increase was partially offset by a decline in crude petroleum exports (-19.3%). By contrast, agricultural exports plunged 21.4%, reflecting lower sales of palm oil and palm-based products (-25%) and sawlog (-37.9%). Exports to all ten major destinations registered growth, led by the US (130.4%), Singapore (58.5%), China (19.9%), and the EU (20%). For January–August, exports totaled MYR 1,356.2 billion, up 31.2% from the same period last year.

【委內瑞拉即將達成協議，將黃金儲備從英國轉移至美國】英國金融時報援引知情人士報道，委內瑞拉政府與反對派即將達成一項協議，把價值約 40 億美元的黃金儲備從英格蘭銀行轉移至紐約聯邦儲備銀行。根據正在磋商的條款，這批黃金有可能被用作政府借貸的抵押品，為財政開支提供資金。政府不得立即出售所持黃金，但將擁有對其的法定控制權。英格蘭銀行表示，除非英國法院出具裁定，明確賬戶的法定歸屬方，否則該行無法執行相關操作。英國外交部、委內瑞拉政府以及反對派均拒絕置評。

Malaysia Imports Beat Expectations — Malaysia’s imports surged 41.1% year-on-year to MYR 163 billion in August 2026, surpassing market expectations of 33.3% and accelerating from 36.4% in July. The latest reading marked the twelfth consecutive month of annual growth, underscoring resilient domestic demand. Import growth was driven primarily by the manufacturing sector, where purchases rose 43.2%, led by the manufacture of electrical and electronic products (89.3%), machinery, equipment and parts (22%), and petroleum products (26.6%). Imports for the mining sector also climbed sharply (60.1%), supported by a strong increase in crude petroleum purchases (87%). In contrast, imports declined for agriculture (-2.9%) and other sectors (-5.9%). By trading partner, imports recorded the strongest increases from China (61.3%), followed by Taiwan (68.9%), Singapore (59.1%), and the US (3.2%). For the January-August period, total imports reached MYR 1,157.6 billion, from MYR 946.1 billion in the corresponding period a year earlier.

【賽力斯康波：問界堅持高階出海，將亮相10月的巴黎車展】9月15日，鴻蒙智行和問界汽車同日釋出說明，宣佈即日起問界在鴻蒙智行合作框架下探索新合作模式，問界品牌將專屬專營。賽力斯集團董事、副總裁康波表示，新合作模式意味著問界邁入新發展階段，問界專屬升級、問界專營管理。這實際上是賽力斯與華為跨界融合模式的再一次創新，在現有合作基礎上，進一步以使用者為中心，圍繞問界自身的品牌定位、產品規劃和服務體驗，把已經形成的高階品牌價值持續做深、做透，讓問界的高階價值更純粹、更精準地傳遞給使用者，讓使用者自豪。康波強調，所有問界使用者的既有權益及後續服務不受影響。華為終端持續參與賦能，作為引望的股東，問界將有華為最新、最好、最實用的技術、產品以及供應保障。康波同時也提到，問界堅持高階出海，將亮相10月的巴黎車展。（一財）

【面向東盟開展資料合作 世界資料組織新設立分支機構】從國家資料局瞭解到，世界資料組織中國—東盟資料合作專業委員會於9月17日在廣西南寧成立。世界資料組織是全球首個旨在推動資料發展與治理實踐的專業性國際組織，總部設在北京，其新成立的中國—東盟資料合作專業委員會重點面向東盟開展資料跨境流動、智慧算力普惠、規則標準共建、會員生態建設、產業集聚發展等業務，致力於彌合資料鴻溝，釋放資料價值，繁榮數字經濟發展。國家資料局表示，將積極參與全球資料治理，支援世界資料組織充分發揮會員在全球地域和行業領域的專業優勢，務實推動垂類領域資料國際合作。

Yen Weakens as BOJ Hikes Rates — The Japanese yen weakened to around 157 per dollar on Friday, touching two-week lows after the Bank of Japan delivered a widely anticipated interest-rate hike. The central bank lifted its policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%, its highest level since April 1995, as policymakers contend with persistent inflationary pressures and ongoing disruptions from the Middle East. The decision was not unanimous, however, with board members Toichiro Asada and Ayano Sato voting against the increase. Attention now turns to the BOJ’s guidance on the scope and timing of further policy tightening. Analysts have indicated that Japan’s tightening cycle may struggle to match the pace of Federal Reserve rate increases, following the Fed’s hawkish hike earlier this week. Meanwhile, Japan’s core inflation slowed to 1.7% in August from 1.8% in July, marking its first decline in four months.

Malaysia Trade Surplus Beats Forecasts — Malaysia’s trade surplus stood at MYR 28.1 billion in August 2026, up from MYR 15.9 billion in the same month a year earlier and surpassing market expectations of MYR 25.3 billion, as exports grew more than imports. Exports jumped 45.5% year-on-year to MYR 191.1 billion, mainly boosted by a 50.4% jump in manufactured goods, which accounted for 88.8% of total exports, particularly E&E products (66.5%). By destination, exports grew sharply to the US (130.4%), Singapore (58.5%), China (19.9%), Taiwan (102.2%), and the EU (20.0%). Meanwhile, imports jumped 41.1% yoy to MYR 163.0 billion, due mainly to a sharp rise in intermediate goods (50.5%) and capital goods (37.4%). In contrast, consumption goods fell 1.6%. Purchases from China surged 61.3%, those from Singapore soared 59.1%, while those from Taiwan jumped 68.9%. In the first eight months of the year, the trade surplus jumped 127.6% yoy to MYR 198.7 billion, with exports rising 31.2% and imports advancing 22.4%.

【上半年A股上市公司繳稅2.5萬億元 稅負平穩】今年以來一些上市公司披露補稅公告引起市場關注，但整體來看上市公司稅負平穩。 從稅務部門瞭解到，根據上市公司公開財務資料，今年上半年，A股上市公司繳納各項稅費2.53萬億元，同比增長4.5%，這一增速明顯低於營業收入（7.6%）和淨利潤（19.5%）增速，也低於上半年全國稅收收入增速（5.3%）。今年上半年A股公司綜合稅負（繳納稅費佔營業收入的比重）較去年同期降低0.2個百分點至6.7%。今年上半年上市公司繳納稅收佔稅務部門徵收的稅收收入比重接近26%，自2023年以來基本穩定在這個水平。 那麼為何今年以來披露補稅的上市公司數量和金額有所增多？這主要是上市公司合規意識尤其是稅法遵從度提升，以及對涉稅事項的披露意願明顯增強。（第一財經）

Copper Holds Gains on Stronger China Demand — Copper futures held above $6.55 per pound on Friday after advancing for three straight sessions, supported by signs of stronger demand from China. The Yangshan premium, a key indicator of Chinese copper demand, climbed to $121 a ton on Thursday, reaching its highest level since November 2022. Copper was also supported by expectations of sustained long-term consumption from data centers and renewable energy projects, along with supply disruptions at several major mines. Earlier in the week, however, copper prices dropped to multi-week lows following reports that the Trump administration had postponed a decision on potential tariffs on refined copper. Meanwhile, warehouses monitored by the London Metal Exchange recorded fresh deliveries, with inflows reaching their highest level in nearly four weeks. The increase in inventories pushed London copper into contango, pointing to ample availability in the near term.

Rupee Rebounds on Lower Oil, IPO Inflows — The Indian rupee strengthened to around 95.7 per dollar, rebounding from seven-week lows as easing crude oil prices, expectations of foreign portfolio inflows linked to the National Stock Exchange’s $2.3 billion IPO and likely RBI intervention supported the currency. Brent crude fell for a third straight session to around $104.1 a barrel as hopes of alternative routes for Middle Eastern oil to reach markets outweighed supply concerns, while a modest retreat in US bond yields also provided relief. Traders expect sizeable foreign institutional investor demand for the NSE IPO, which closes for subscription on Monday. The rupee held near 96 per dollar on Thursday despite the Federal Reserve’s rate hike, recovering after likely RBI intervention and portfolio inflows linked to global equity index rebalancing. However, strong importer dollar demand and elevated oil prices remain headwinds, while the dollar stays above 100 following the Fed’s hawkish stance.

【花旗：美聯儲漸進加息對中國香港銀行盈利略偏正面 首選股為中銀香港】花旗釋出研報稱，美聯儲昨日加息25個基點，將聯邦基金利率目標區間上調至3.75釐至4釐，點陣圖中位數顯示今年仍有一次25個基點加息;遠期曲線預期至2027年底前再加息3次，終端利率預計達4.5%至4.75%。該行認為，美聯儲漸進加息對中國香港銀行盈利略偏正面，中銀香港(02388)是該行中國香港銀行股首選。

【日本一核電站反應堆因漏水暫時關停】日本關西電力公司稱，已於今天（9月18日）凌晨暫時關停了位於福井縣的美浜核電站3號機組反應堆執行，原因是“可能存在管道漏水的情況”。據稱，當地時間9月17日15時45分（北京時間14時45分）左右，工作人員在對美浜核電站3號機組進行巡檢時，發現管道排氣閥周邊有水滴落。關西電力公司稱，據判斷這一情況“不會立刻對機組執行造成影響”，但仍於當地時間今天凌晨4時（北京時間3時）左右手動關停反應堆。目前尚未確定恢復執行的時間。關西電力公司稱，滴落的水滴“不含放射性物質，不會對周邊環境造成影響”。

【美國司法部反壟斷官員：AI安全協調不構成反競爭行為】美國司法部一名反壟斷官員週四表示，在安全問題上的協調並不構成反競爭行為。美國司法部反壟斷局負責人Stanley Woodward在紐約福特漢姆大學表示，司法部正在審議是否更新現行指導方針，以允許企業在網路安全方面進行協調。“在我看來，就網路安全或其他安全問題進行協調並不構成反競爭行為，”他說。

【國泰君安期貨公司增資至75億】天眼查App顯示，近日，國泰君安期貨有限公司發生工商變更，註冊資本由70億人民幣增至75億人民幣。該公司成立於2000年4月，法定代表人為張燁燁，經營範圍為商品期貨經紀、金融期貨經紀、期貨投資諮詢、資產管理。股東資訊顯示，該公司由國泰海通證券股份有限公司全資持股。

【渣打：美聯儲主席沃什可能已製造了賣出美元的障礙】渣打銀行表示，美聯儲主席凱文·沃什可能已經移除了買入美元的最大障礙，同時製造了賣出美元的最大障礙。渣打銀行G10外匯研究全球主管Steve Englander在9月17日致客戶的報告中寫道，之前買入美元的最大障礙是貨幣貶值擔憂。他補充說，賣出美元的最大障礙是，名義和實際利差讓美元作為融資貨幣缺乏吸引力，使得美元資產持有者的對沖成本高昂。Englander認為，沃什可能已經消減了美元短線上漲的阻力，因為聯邦公開市場委員會加息25個基點，讓市場對追逐高收益率更放心，而且增加了對沖成本。他表示，目前美元面臨的最大風險是美國經濟增長前景下滑。

【湖北首單“認股權+擔保”登記落地武漢股交】近日，武漢股權託管交易中心（簡稱“武漢股交”）辦理湖北首單“認股權+擔保”登記業務，促成湖北省科技融資擔保有限公司為其網路安全領域科技型客戶辦結認股權確權登記手續。這是繼“園區服務+認股權”之後，武漢股交認股權業務拓展的又一全新應用場景，標誌著湖北區域性股權市場在“認股權+擔保”方向實現新突破，為輕資產科技型企業融資增信提供了創新解決方案。下一步，武漢股交將加大認股權業務的推廣和落地力度，深化與銀行、擔保機構、園區、產業資本等各方主體的協同聯動。

【國產大飛機研製新進展：C929正在穩步設計階段】截至目前，國產大飛機C919安全執行超15萬小時，載客突破800萬人次，通航26座城市。在第四屆中國航協航空大會展區，有兩個C919模型是正在研製中的新機型。一個是縮短型，可滿足高原地區的民航運輸需求；另一個是加長型，比已交付的機型多了近80個座位。據瞭解，C929正在穩步設計階段。（央視新聞）

【韓國總統稱不會向霍爾木茲海峽派兵“介入戰爭”】當地時間18日，韓國總統李在明就是否會向霍爾木茲海峽派兵一事，在記者會上表示，韓國“不會派兵參與或介入戰爭”，同時將研究加強保護韓國商船、原油運輸線路及國民安全的相關措施。李在明當天在青瓦臺舉行的記者會上表示，韓國一直堅持“不派遣軍事力量參與或介入戰爭”的原則，今後這一原則也不會改變。不過，他表示，韓國“也必須像其他國家一樣，開展保護本國商船、原油運輸路線以及國民生命安全所必需的最低限度活動”。他說，韓國已經派遣部隊應對海盜等對韓國國民安全構成威脅的情況，“事實上，我們正在研究和認真考慮進一步加強相關力量”。李在明強調，外界似乎擔心韓國派兵會意味著介入或支援戰爭，甚至派遣作戰部隊，他再次強調，韓國不會派兵參與戰爭。（央視新聞）

【韓國總統承認單一股票槓桿ETF存在不足，但未就投資者損失道歉】韓國總統李在明週五承認，今年早些時候推出的單一股票槓桿交易所交易基金（ETF）存在不足之處。李在明在記者會上表示，這類產品是在股市上漲行情接近尾聲時推出的，隨後市場轉向給投資者造成了巨大損失。不過李在明並未就此道歉，也未點名相關政策的決策責任人。

【韓國濟州道知事：將延續對中國公民免籤政策】據“中國駐韓國大使館”公眾號訊息，9月17日，戴兵大使在使館會見韓國濟州道知事魏聖坤。駐濟州總領事陳建軍參加。戴兵祝賀魏聖坤就任，表示中韓互為重要近鄰和合作伙伴，加強友好合作最符合兩國根本利益。在兩國元首戰略引領下，當前中韓關係穩中向好發展。濟州與中國交往十分密切，深受中國遊客喜愛。希望濟州不斷加強對華交流合作，並繼續為中國遊客提供安全、健康的旅遊環境。魏聖坤錶示，濟州與中國淵源深厚，對華交流合作密切。我長期在濟州工作生活，曾任韓國國會韓中議員聯盟成員，高度重視韓中友好合作。濟州希同中國山東、海南等地加強務實合作和人文交流，將延續對中國公民免籤政策，歡迎更多中國遊客往訪。

【東方金誠白雪：美聯儲不會開啟連續加息週期】東方金誠研究發展部高階副總監白雪9月18日表示，美聯儲年內再加息一次的機率顯著上升，但這並不意味著美聯儲將開啟連續加息週期。首先，當前美國經濟雖有韌性，但K型分化特徵明顯，居民儲蓄率偏低、消費可持續性下降的問題逐步顯現，AI投資週期也可能面臨邊際走弱。其次，長端美債收益率已攀升至2007年以來高位，金融條件的自發收緊已對利率敏感部門形成實質性壓制，美聯儲仍需謹慎評估緊縮政策的累積效應。再次，本次加息的核心目的是鎖定通脹預期、防範通脹再度固化，屬於階段性政策調整，而非應對經濟過熱和通脹螺旋式抬升的系統性緊縮。而當前美國通脹只是出現階段性反彈，並未形成工資—物價螺旋，基本面也不支援持續加息。9月加息落地後，若12月通脹資料仍偏強，則可能再加息一次。隨後美聯儲將進入觀察期，在4.00%—4.25%的利率水平上觀察通脹向目標回落的進度，再決定下一步是維持、加息還是轉向降息。
【蘋果回應iPhone Duo維修貴】針對iPhone Duo官方維修價格，記者以消費者身份諮詢蘋果官方客服。客服表示，目前iPhone Duo尚未開啟預購，具體維修價格待預購後公佈。客服稱，iPhone Duo採用內外雙屏設計，維修費用可能“確實比較昂貴”。以iPhone 18 Pro Max為例，螢幕損壞正常維修費用為3198元。 (中新經緯)

【北環線支線香港段鐵路方案獲授權進行】香港特區政府今日（18日）按《鐵路條例》（第519章）的規定，就運輸及物流局局長批准北環線支線香港段鐵路方案刊登憲報。北環線專案（包括北環線主線和支線）是推動北部都會區發展和助力香港更好融入國家發展的重要運輸基建，配合國家“十五五”規劃綱要提出加快北部都會區建設，促進軌道交通協同發展。北環線支線包括從主線新田站開始一條約六公里長的地下鐵路，當中香港段長約五公里，深圳段則長約一公里。北環線支線將設三個新鐵路站，包括香港段位於新田科技城的洲頭和河套地區兩個新鐵路站，以及深圳段於新皇崗口岸設定的一個新鐵路站。 作為北環線專案的跨境分支，除服務新田科技城及河套地區外，北環線支線亦連線新皇崗口岸，連通香港和深圳的地鐵網路，便利港深兩地人員流動，兼備香港本地通勤和跨境鐵路服務的功能，有助推動粵港澳大灣區基礎設施“硬聯通”。 北環線支線香港段鐵路方案於刊憲期間沒有收到反對意見，足見專案一直獲得社會的廣泛支援。隨著鐵路方案獲授權進行，北環線支線香港段的建造工程會盡快展開，目標是讓北環線支線與主線在2034年或之前同步開通，屆時往來新田和新皇崗口岸的行程預計只需約11分鐘。（大灣區之聲）

Offshore Yuan Strongest Since 2022 — The offshore yuan strengthened to around 6.69 per dollar on Friday, extending gains from the previous session and reaching its strongest level since July 2022, as a firmer daily fixing from the People’s Bank of China continued to support the currency. The central bank set the daily midpoint at 6.7521 per dollar, stronger than Thursday’s 6.7580, marking an upward bias in the fixing for an eighth consecutive session and the longest such run since 2023. The move indicated that the central bank may be increasingly comfortable with a stronger yuan ahead of President Donald Trump’s meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping in the US on September 24. BoJ Hikes Rate to 31-Year High — The Bank of Japan lifted its key short-term rate by 25bps to 1.25% in a 7-2 vote at its September meeting, marking the highest level since April 1995 and in line with market expectations. The hike, the first in three months, reflected persistent inflationary pressures, including those stemming from higher oil prices, and marked another step away from decades of ultra-low rates. Policymakers said they would continue to raise the policy rate and adjust monetary accommodation in response to economic activity, prices and financial conditions, while considering the timing and pace of further adjustments. Core CPI inflation has been rising moderately as higher business-to-business prices spill over into consumer prices and firms pass higher wages on to selling prices. Upside risks of inflation exceeding the 2% target remain, with the board adding that it would closely monitor the impact of the Middle East conflict. The dissenting votes came from board members Toichiro Asada and Ayano Sato.

Soybeans Remain Firm Ahead of Trump-Xi Talks — Soybean futures traded above $13.1 per bushel, near their highest level in almost three years supported by stronger Chinese demand for US supplies and expectations of further purchases ahead of high-level US-China talks. China has already passed the halfway mark of its commitment to purchase 25 million metric tons of US soybeans, while recent US export sales have remained firm, confirmed at about 1.7 million metric tons, driven largely by Chinese demand. The buying comes ahead of a planned meeting between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping next week, raising hopes for progress on agricultural trade and potentially lower tariffs on US farm goods. Meanwhile attention remains on the US harvest, with heavy Midwest rains slowing fieldwork in some areas and potentially providing near-term support to prices. Brazil’s 2026/27 crop is also in focus as planting gets underway, with forecasts pointing to another record harvest, although growth is expected to be modest.

Indonesian Shares Track Back-to-Back Weekly Losses — Indonesia’s IDX Composite added 27 points or 0.4% to 6,488 in Friday morning trade, extending prior gains after Wall Street’s overnight rally as oil prices eased and Treasury yields slipped in the wake of the Fed’s rate hike shock. Domestically, Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara vowed to uphold a credible budget, with economists noting his fiscal expertise and long tenure at the ministry. Strength in energy, tech, and basic materials underpinned the advance, though losses in financials and infrastructure capped momentum. Notable movers included Mitra Adiperkasa (3.4%), Medco Energi (1.6%), Hartadinata Abadi (1.4%), and Vale Indonesia (1.1%). However, the market remains on track for a second consecutive weekly decline, down about 0.8% so far, pressured by growing inflation concerns tied to higher oil prices and looming El Niño risks. Caution also lingered ahead of Bank Indonesia’s policy meeting next week, with renewed rupiah weakness and signs of foreign outflows weighing on sentiment.

New Zealand Dollar Falls Back — The New Zealand dollar slipped to around $0.571 on Friday, moving back near a ten-week low after rising 0.3% in the previous session, as a firmer US dollar continued to weigh on the currency. The greenback clung to a seven-week high after the Federal Reserve hiked rates and signaled further tightening ahead. This outweighed support from better-than-expected domestic data. New Zealand’s GDP growth in the second quarter beat estimates, suggesting some resilience in economic activity despite the severe energy shock from US-Iran war. In addition, the country’s trade deficit for August was smaller than forecast, with export growth outpacing the increase in imports. Meanwhile, markets are pricing in a 60% chance that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand will raise its cash rate again to 3.0% at its October meeting. The kiwi was down around 1.6% so far this week, marking its fourth consecutive weekly decline.

US Natgas Prices Drop Over 1% — US natural gas prices fell more than 1% to $2.85/MMBtu on Friday, erasing the previous session’s gains as weather forecasts turned cooler. Above-average temperatures are now expected to cover a smaller area of the South and Southeast from September 22 to October 1, potentially curbing gas demand from power generators for air conditioning. Prices had risen on Thursday after the EIA reported a below-average storage build for the week ended September 11, narrowing the inventory surplus over the five-year average to 118 Bcf from 148 Bcf a week earlier, as late-season heat boosted power-sector demand. Strong production also continued to weigh on the market, with Lower 48 production averaging 113.1 bcfd in September, above August’s record monthly average of 112.2 bcfd. At the same time, average flows to the nine major US LNG export facilities were expected to fall to a three-week low of 17.5 bcfd, primarily due to maintenance at Cameron LNG in Louisiana.

【Daiwa Securities warns of rising risk of prolonged inflation in Japan】Daiwa Securities economist Kento Minami said the risk of prolonged inflation in Japan is increasing as crude oil rebounds and firms increasingly pass higher costs to consumers. 【China housing ministry says completed-home sales are the trend】At a State Council Information Office briefing, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD) said completed-home sales are the prevailing trend and urged new projects to prioritize sales of completed properties to prevent sell-before-delivery risks. Citing National Bureau of Statistics data, MOHURD said completed-home sales area has grown and its share of new-home sales has risen in recent years. It called for coordinated land, financial and tax support for projects that opt for completed-sales and said where presales are used authorities should strengthen presale fund supervision to protect buyers' legal rights.

【華圖教育：從未委託任何機構或個人辦理“退費清退”，已報案】華圖教育9月17日晚釋出宣告稱，近日，有不法分子冒用華圖教育名義實施退費詐騙：向學員寄送紙質“退費通知函”、傳送電子“退費函”或撥打電話、簡訊，謊稱可辦理全額退費，誘導學員掃碼新增所謂“線上客服”。經核實，上述檔案中的《華圖教育退費公告》（冒用教育部名義，文號教材〔2026〕5號）、《關於華圖教育退費辦理及相關流程的公告》（冒用市場監督管理總局名義，文號京市監〔2026〕108號），及其加蓋的“國家市場監督管理總局辦公廳”印章，均系偽造。公司從未釋出此類公告，亦從未委託任何機構或個人辦理“退費清退”。公司已向公安機關報案並固定證據，將依法追究相關主體的民事、行政及刑事責任，絕不姑息。

【住房城鄉建設部：現房銷售是大勢所趨】國新辦舉行“開局起步‘十五五’”系列主題新聞釋出會。住房城鄉建設部有關負責人介紹，當前，房地產市場出現了“兩個轉變”。一個是房地產市場供求關係發生重大變化；一個是房地產進入存量時代，二手房交易佔比從2020年的27%提高到2025年的46%，今年前8個月已經達到52%，超過50%標誌著進入存量時代。“十五五”時期，住房城鄉建設部將積極適應房地產的新形勢新變化，統籌防風險和促轉型，統籌惠民生和穩增長，加快構建房地產發展新模式，健全多主體供給、多渠道保障、租購併舉的住房制度，推動房地產高質量發展。在商品房銷售上，推進現房銷售制，解決專案銷售“一手交錢，一手交房”的問題，實現“所見即所得”，從根本上防範交付風險。現房銷售是大勢所趨，從國家統計局資料來看，近年來現房的銷售面積保持正增長，佔新房銷售面積的比重逐年提高。新專案優先選擇現房銷售，統籌用好針對專案的土地、金融、稅收等支援政策；實行預售的，完善預售資金監管，切實維護購房人合法權益。

【UNWTO cuts 2026 global international tourist arrivals forecast to 1–2%】The UN World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) on the 17th lowered its 2026 forecast for global international tourist arrivals to 1–2% growth from a prior 3–4% range. Its World Tourism Barometer showed arrivals rose just 0.4% YoY in 1H to about 690 mln, roughly 3 mln more than a year earlier. Arrivals were up 2% YoY in Q1 but fell 1% in Q2; June was down 3% YoY. The UNWTO said Middle East arrivals fell 22% YoY in 1H, directly affected by the regional conflict.

US 10-Year Yield Holds Decline — The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note held around 4.94% on Friday after losing almost 10 basis points in the previous session, retreating from 19-year highs as softer oil prices eased inflation concerns. Oil prices fell for a third consecutive session as Saudi Arabia took steps to resume flows through its East-West pipeline, while President Donald Trump is expected to meet with Gulf leaders next week. Markets also continued to assess the Federal Reserve’s policy direction after the central bank raised interest rates by 25 basis points this week, marking its first hike in three years. The Fed indicated that additional tightening could be pursued later this year to curb persistent price pressures, with Chair Kevin Warsh emphasizing that inflation remains elevated. The Bank of Japan is likewise expected to increase rates, while the Bank of England kept borrowing costs unchanged on Thursday but warned that a prolonged Middle East conflict could eventually prompt further tightening.

【China to raise housing quality across 14 areas, MOHURD says】China’s Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD) told a government briefing it will boost residential quality by focusing on building “good homes” — defined as safe, comfortable, green and smart. China Stocks Rebound on Oil Retreat, Tech Gains — The Shanghai Composite rose 0.5% to around 3,900, while the Shenzhen Component gained 0.8% to 13,500 on Friday, rebounding from the previous session as easing oil prices improved risk sentiment, while markets watched the upcoming high-level US-China talks. 【美銀證券：贛鋒鋰業鋰價回撥反映多重憂慮 公司指市場需求預期已過於悲觀】美銀證券釋出研報稱，贛鋒鋰業(01772)在電話會議上討論近期鋰價弱勢，似乎反映多重市場憂慮，包括主要行業參與者削減訂單的傳聞、電池出貨強勁但下游儲能裝機及電動車銷售未跟上所引發的供需錯配及庫存累積憂慮、上海有色網(SMM)資料修訂所引發的隱性庫存猜測，以及高倉單未必代表庫存充裕等問題。該行維持"買入"評級，H股目標價70港元。該行指，贛鋒不同意悲觀論調，不認為電池持有大量庫存，公司庫存偏低、行業偏緊，現貨供需非常緊張，今年處於短缺且去庫存持續，並非需求崩潰的市場。公司假設明年供應增長20%至25%、需求增長約25%，認為市場需求預期已過於悲觀;公平鋰價約為15萬元人民幣，但10萬至12萬元人民幣是關鍵支撐，成本上升快於預期，在12萬元人民幣水平已可見供應減少。

【Ministry: housing and urban construction faces new dynamics in 15th Five-Year Plan period】At a State Council Information Office briefing today, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development said the housing and urban-rural development sector will face new dynamics during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. The ministry identified three main segments—urban-rural construction, housing and real estate, and the construction industry—each at a critical transformation point. For urban-rural construction it described two shifts: urbanization is moving from rapid expansion to stable growth, and city development is shifting from large-scale incremental expansion to stock-focused quality and efficiency improvements. For housing and real estate it cited two transitions: a significant change in market supply-demand dynamics and a move into a stock era. For the construction industry it outlined a threefold transformation toward intelligence, greening and integration.

【住房城鄉建設部：住建事業“十五五”時期面臨新形勢】今天，國新辦舉行“開局起步‘十五五’”系列主題新聞釋出會，住房城鄉建設部有關負責人介紹，住建事業“十五五”時期面臨新形勢，住建事業主要有城鄉建設、住房和房地產、建築業三大板塊。三大板塊都處在轉型發展的關鍵期，概括起來是“兩個轉向、兩個轉變、三化轉型”。“兩個轉向”講的是城鄉建設板塊，是指城鎮化正從快速增長期轉向穩定發展期，城市發展正從大規模增量擴張階段轉向存量提質增效為主的階段；“兩個轉變”講的是住房和房地產板塊，一個是房地產市場供求關係發生重大變化，一個是房地產進入存量時代；“三化轉型”講的是建築業板塊，也就是建築業向智慧化、綠色化、融合化轉型。（央視新聞）

【中國三峽建工（集團）有限公司原一級諮詢陳文夫被"雙開"】中央紀委國家監委網站9月18日通報，據中央紀委國家監委駐中國三峽集團紀檢監察組、湖北省紀委監委訊息：日前，經中央紀委國家監委批准，中央紀委國家監委駐中國三峽集團紀檢監察組、湖北省宜昌市監委對中國三峽建工（集團）有限公司原一級諮詢陳文夫嚴重違紀違法問題進行了立案審查調查。經查，陳文夫作為黨員領導幹部，喪失理想信念，背棄初心使命，對黨不忠誠不老實，在組織談話時不如實說清問題，妄圖透過社會騙子規避組織調查，與他人串供，處心積慮對抗組織審查；無視中央八項規定精神，收受可能影響公正執行公務的禮品、禮金，接受可能影響公正執行公務的宴請和娛樂活動安排；違反組織原則，在職工錄用中為他人謀取利益；廉潔底線失守，向管理服務物件借用錢款，參與民間借貸獲取大額回報，將應由特定關係人個人支付的費用安排管理服務物件支付；追求低階趣味；貪慾膨脹，將權力異化為謀取私利的工具，利用職務便利為他人在工程專案承攬、結算等方面謀取利益，並非法收受鉅額財物。陳文夫嚴重違反黨的政治紀律、組織紀律、廉潔紀律、生活紀律，構成嚴重職務違法並涉嫌受賄犯罪，且在黨的十八大後不收斂、不收手，性質嚴重，影響惡劣，應予嚴肅處理。依據《中國共產黨紀律處分條例》《中華人民共和國監察法》《中華人民共和國公職人員政務處分法》等有關規定，經中國三峽集團黨組研究，決定給予陳文夫開除黨籍處分；經中央紀委國家監委駐中國三峽集團紀檢監察組研究，決定給予陳文夫開除公職處分；追繳其違紀違法所得。湖北省宜昌市監委將其涉嫌犯罪問題移送檢察機關依法審查起訴，所涉財物一併移送。

【市場監管總局釋出首個鈣鈦礦光伏領域國家標準】市場監管總局釋出首個鈣鈦礦光伏領域國家標準《光伏器件 第12部分：鈣鈦礦光伏電池及元件的電流-電壓（I-V）特性測量方法》，將於2027年正式實施。在“雙碳”目標推動下，鈣鈦礦光伏技術發展迅速，正從實驗室走向吉瓦級大規模量產，電池及元件的測試認證需求不斷增長。但鈣鈦礦器件在光照和電壓變化下效能容易波動，測試結果不夠穩定，面積定義也尚未統一，過去常用於晶矽和薄膜電池的測試方法難以直接套用。簡單來說，該標準要解決的是鈣鈦礦電池和元件到底該怎麼測才能測得準、比得公平。鈣鈦礦器件在光照下效能會變化，不能像傳統晶矽那樣快速一測即可。該標準系統規定了測試裝置、測試前的穩定化處理要求，以及如何測量電流-電壓特性、如何計算面積和發電效率等。針對實驗室研發和規模化生產的不同需要，該標準給出快速測量法，並補充最大功率點追蹤法、十點準穩態擬合法（仲裁法）、漸進法等更貼近真實工作狀態的準穩態測試方法。同時，該標準統一總面積與光闌面積定義及效率計算，讓不同機構測出的結果可以放在同一把標尺上比較，最終形成一套可驗證、可復現的標準化測試流程。該標準構建了科學、可靠、可推廣的鈣鈦礦光伏I-V特性測量方法體系，填補了我國在新興光伏技術標準化測試領域的空白。它將成為檢測認證、產品研發、產線質控和貿易交付的“統一標尺”，為後續標準體系完善、國際標準制定及鈣鈦礦光伏產業化推廣應用提供關鍵技術支撐。

【RBA: Inflation risks skewed to the upside; inflation expectations may be shifting】Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Bullock told a parliamentary committee firms are increasingly forming a view that high inflation may not fall back below 3%. 【加強涉企侵權資訊管理 中央網信辦要求平臺主動清理五大類】中央網信辦釋出《關於加強涉企侵權資訊管理 持續推動營商網路環境最佳化的通知》，通知明確處置範圍，內容如下：處置涉企侵權資訊，事關企業、企業家切身利益，事關人民群眾切身權益。經過一段時間實踐，各方對處置涉企侵權資訊已形成共識。網站平臺對以下涉企侵權資訊，應當積極主動清理處置。1.個人資訊類。包括洩露企業家身份證、護照、戶籍檔案、家庭住址、電話號碼等個人身份及聯絡資訊，以及生物識別、醫療健康、金融賬戶、行蹤軌跡等敏感個人資訊。2.侮辱貶損類。包括侮辱謾罵企業、企業家，惡搞醜化企業標識、產品和企業家肖像，將企業、企業家與色情低俗話題惡意關聯，使用汙名化詞彙詆譭企業、企業家或特定品牌使用者。3.假冒仿冒類。包括假冒仿冒新聞單位制作釋出的涉企監督資訊，假借企業或企業家名義釋出的資訊，在公眾賬號名稱、頭像、簡介中，擅自使用與企業相同或相似的名稱標識或企業家姓名肖像。4.虛假誤導類。包括斷章取義、歪曲解讀企業家過往言論，呈現與事實不符的搜尋關鍵詞聯想、搜尋落地頁結果，已經權威闢謠、澄清的不實資訊，與企業、企業家在超大平臺上的官方賬號釋出的公開宣告不符資訊。5.其他類。包括涉企拉踩引戰資訊，集納翻炒的企業舊聞舊事、負面資訊，已被本平臺處置過的涉企侵權資訊，機器人賬號、網路水軍賬號釋出的涉企評論資訊，明顯違背公序良俗抹黑詆譭企業、企業家資訊。網站平臺應當根據本通知要求，健全資訊內容管理制度，完善最佳化平臺社群規則，將涉企資訊納入日常內容稽核處置範圍，強化賬號、MCN機構管理，切實增強工作主動性、針對性和實效性。網信部門要落實屬地管理責任，指導所在地網站平臺完善制度，加強涉企資訊內容管理，及時清理涉企侵權資訊。對重視程度不足、落實力度不夠特別是網民反映問題集中的網站平臺，依法依規從嚴處理。

US Heating Oil Prices Ease — US heating oil prices eased to around $5.05 per gallon, retreating from a record high of $5.26 reached earlier this week, as rising inventories and expectations of alternative routes for Middle Eastern barrels offered some respite from tight distillate supplies. EIA data showed distillate inventories, including diesel and heating oil, rose by 1.6 million barrels in the week ended September 11 but remained 13% below their five-year average. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia was reportedly seeking to restore about half the capacity of its East-West oil pipeline within days after drone attacks halted the key link to the Red Sea, while offering additional crude cargoes to Asian refiners via ship-to-ship transfers off Oman’s Sohar port. Still, supply risks persisted as Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthi forces exchanged fresh strikes. With winter approaching, distillate demand could strengthen, while refinery maintenance could constrain production and put further pressure on already-tight supplies.

【NDRC, NEA and national mine safety regulator order measures to stabilize coal production and supply】China's NDRC, NEA and the National Mine Safety Administration issued a joint notice directing coal-producing provinces and coal firms to, while ensuring safety, accelerate measures to stabilize production and secure supply. The notice mandates stronger monitoring and dispatch, optimized production planning, expedited mine resumptions and full-capacity restarts, and faster acceptance of jointly trial-run mines to support a steady rebound in coal output. It also requires tighter signing and performance of medium- and long-term thermal-coal contracts, use of imports to supplement domestic supply, and advancement of follow-up coal capacity construction. Authorities said they will enhance coordination, guide implementation, adjust policies and, where appropriate, timely release coal-capacity reserves to stabilize production and market functioning.

Australia Shares Inch Higher, Weekly Picture Muted — Australian stocks edged up 14 points, or 0.2%, to 8,747 in early Friday trade, extending gains for a third straight session after Wall Street rebounded overnight as easing oil prices and softer Treasury yields helped calm nerves after the Fed’s rate-hike shock. Strength came from tech, non-energy minerals, and consumer durables, though losses in healthcare, energy minerals, and retail trade capped the upside. Gold miners advanced, with Northern Star Resources up 2.7% and Evolution Mining rising 3.0%, while Lynas Rare Earths, Perseus Mining, and South32 each added over 2%. For the week, the market was little changed, stabilizing after recent declines as traders weighed remarks from RBA Governor Michele Bullock, who warned that upside inflation risks are emerging amid surging global energy costs from the prolonged Middle East conflict, compounded by pressures from the AI data-centre boom and extreme weather.

【加拿大對進口罐裝蔬菜產品作出保障措施終裁】近日，WTO保障措施委員會發布加拿大代表團向其提交的保障措施通報。加拿大國際貿易法庭（CITT）於2026年9月9日對進口罐頭蔬菜產品（Canned Vegetable Goods）作出保障措施肯定性終裁，認定進口增加是造成國內產業嚴重損害的主要原因，建議以關稅配額形式實施保障措施。具體如下：第1年配額為13,000,000公斤，超配額附加稅為50%；第2年配額為13,260,000公斤，超配額附加稅為45%；第3年配額為13,525,200公斤，超配額附加稅為40%。措施建議實施3年，至2030年1月5日。

【中央網信辦：加強涉企侵權資訊管理 持續推動營商網路環境最佳化】中央網信辦釋出《關於加強涉企侵權資訊管理 持續推動營商網路環境最佳化的通知》，通知指出，處置涉企侵權資訊，事關企業、企業家切身利益，事關人民群眾切身權益。經過一段時間實踐，各方對處置涉企侵權資訊已形成共識。網站平臺對以下涉企侵權資訊，應當積極主動清理處置。1.個人資訊類。包括洩露企業家身份證、護照、戶籍檔案、家庭住址、電話號碼等個人身份及聯絡資訊，以及生物識別、醫療健康、金融賬戶、行蹤軌跡等敏感個人資訊。2.侮辱貶損類。包括侮辱謾罵企業、企業家，惡搞醜化企業標識、產品和企業家肖像，將企業、企業家與色情低俗話題惡意關聯，使用汙名化詞彙詆譭企業、企業家或特定品牌使用者。3.假冒仿冒類。包括假冒仿冒新聞單位制作釋出的涉企監督資訊，假借企業或企業家名義釋出的資訊，在公眾賬號名稱、頭像、簡介中，擅自使用與企業相同或相似的名稱標識或企業家姓名肖像。4.虛假誤導類。包括斷章取義、歪曲解讀企業家過往言論，呈現與事實不符的搜尋關鍵詞聯想、搜尋落地頁結果，已經權威闢謠、澄清的不實資訊，與企業、企業家在超大平臺上的官方賬號釋出的公開宣告不符資訊。5.其他類。包括涉企拉踩引戰資訊，集納翻炒的企業舊聞舊事、負面資訊，已被本平臺處置過的涉企侵權資訊，機器人賬號、網路水軍賬號釋出的涉企評論資訊，明顯違背公序良俗抹黑詆譭企業、企業家資訊。

Japan 10-Year Yield Falls Ahead of BOJ Verdict — Japan’s 10-year government bond yield slipped to around 2.96% on Friday, extending its decline into a third session as markets positioned for the Bank of Japan’s latest policy decision, with markets widely expecting an interest-rate hike. Investors will also watch for signals on further tightening as policymakers navigate rising inflation and wage growth, along with pressure from US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to pursue more aggressive rate increases. Meanwhile, Japan’s core inflation eased to 1.7% in August from 1.8% in July, marking its first slowdown in four months. However, expectations that price pressures could strengthen in the coming months continued to support a hawkish BOJ outlook, while disruptions in the Middle East added to inflation risks. Japanese bond yields also followed declines in global yields as falling oil prices helped ease concerns over inflation.

【SK Group moves three vice chairmen to SK Hynix】SK Inc., the SK Group holding company, has reassigned three of its four vice chairmen—Seo Jin-Woo, Yu Jeong-Joon and Lee Hyung-Hee—to semiconductor unit SK Hynix, industry sources said. SK Group said the move reflects rising geopolitical uncertainty in the semiconductor sector and aims to bring senior global experience to advise SK Hynix’s operations and support its mid-to-long-term strategy. 【SK集團將三名副董事長調往SK海力士】9月18日，據報道，業內人士透露，SK集團旗下控股公司SK Inc.已將其四名副董事長中的三名調往SK海力士。這三名高管分別是Seo Jin-Woo、Yu Jeong-Joon和Lee Hyung-Hee，他們此前負責領導集團的全球業務和對外合作。SK集團表示，此次人事調動考量了半導體行業日益加劇的地緣政治不確定性。一位公司官員解釋說：“目的是讓具備全球經驗和專業知識的資深高管為SK海力士的整體經營提供建議，並支援中長期願景的制定。”為此，這三位副董事長近期已開始與SK海力士全體高管進行一對一的深入訪談。此外，報道稱，SK集團的職業經理人副董事長團隊也已同時進駐SK海力士。

【Ten ministries, including MIIT and NDRC, back pharma firms targeting frontier science to develop FIC and BIC】Ten ministries, led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the National Development and Reform Commission, today issued the Pharmaceutical Industry “15th Five-Year Plan”, directing stronger original innovation. The plan prioritizes major infectious diseases, major chronic diseases, rare diseases and pediatric medicines, strengthens firms’ role as innovation drivers, and calls for accelerating R&D toward first-in-class, breakthrough and disruptive therapies. It supports pharmaceutical companies in targeting frontier biomedical science to develop new targets, new mechanisms and new drug types — first-in-class (FIC) and best-in-class (BIC) — and urges faster R&D and application of frontier, leading high-end medical devices.

Yen Slips Ahead of BOJ Decision — The Japanese yen weakened past 156 per dollar on Friday, hovering near two-week lows as investors awaited the latest Bank of Japan policy decision, with markets widely expecting an interest-rate hike. Investors will also seek guidance on the potential for further tightening as policymakers contend with rising inflation and wages, alongside pressure from US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent for a more aggressive pace of rate increases. Meanwhile, Japan’s core inflation eased to 1.7% in August from 1.8% in July, marking its first slowdown in four months. However, expectations that price pressures could strengthen in the coming months continued to support a hawkish BOJ outlook, with disruptions stemming from the Middle East adding to inflation risks. Earlier this month, the yen climbed to seven-month highs on expectations of more aggressive BOJ tightening, recent joint interventions by Tokyo and Washington, and prospects of greater capital repatriation by Japanese investors.

【國泰海通：地方新增專項債發行節奏偏慢 預計四季度專項債用途更靈活】國泰海通證券釋出的研報稱，2026年地方政府新增專項債發行節奏偏慢，或與專案儲備不足有關，預計四季度專項債用途或更加靈活，支援化債，供給放量但久期壓力減弱。截至9月11日，全年新增專項債發行金額3.03萬億，佔全年新增專項債限額的68.9%；按照發行計劃推算，9月末進度將達到76.4%。從過去幾年的發行節奏看，9月末通常完成全年限額約九成，10月末專項債基本發完。年內地方債剩餘發行金額預計在2.28萬億元，年內剩餘地方債的發行期限在15.3年附近，較前期有較為明顯下降。進入四季度，新增專項債在當年形成實物工作量的難度加大，部分專案儲備不足的省份可能會增加特殊新增專項債的發行，用途更為靈活。

【Central Cyberspace Administration issues notice clarifying scope for handling enterprise-related infringing information】The Central Cyberspace Administration issued a notice to strengthen management of enterprise-related infringing information and further optimize the business internet environment. It directs platforms to move controls upstream and strengthen source management, tighten website and platform content-management responsibilities, and increase personnel and technology investment. The notice requires a full-chain regime of pre-publication review, real-time patrols and post-publication disposal, proactive removal of explicit enterprise-infringing content, and strict, expedited handling of implicated accounts and MCN firms to address slow or ineffective takedowns.

【BOJ decision preview: 25bp hike expected; yen vulnerable if guidance isn’t hawkish】Most firms expect the BOJ to raise its policy rate by 25bp to 1.25% today; markets are focussing on forward guidance — a less hawkish signal would likely trigger yen weakness and pressure JGBs. Reuters survey: economists expect the policy rate to reach 1.50% by end-March next year and 1.75% by Q2 2027, with most seeing at least that terminal rate. Nikko expects 25bp to 1.25% and 1.75% by June 2027, with upside to 2.25% if oil rises and other central banks tighten. BNP sees 25bp now, then further hikes in Dec and next March to 1.75%. OCBC says the hike is largely priced; the key is the post-September path and whether the BOJ signals faster normalization while inflation remains elevated. Goldman says today’s move is certain and the next hike could come as early as December; high energy, strong AI-driven demand, a weaker yen and loose fiscal policy could push inflation and yields higher. TD Securities projects a path to 2.25% via hikes in Dec and several 2027 moves and warns that omission of Oct/Dec hikes from guidance could send USD/JPY to 157–160. Market pricing already implies ~90bp of tightening over the next 12 months; if Governor Ueda signals caution, that could leave the yen exposed. Overall market takeaway: 25bp hike probable; guidance tone will be the primary driver for near-term yen moves, JGB yields and expectations for further BOJ tightening.

【Ten Chinese ministries push AI, quantum and other frontier tech to speed drug R&D; explore extreme manufacturing and space-based drug production】Ten Chinese ministries and agencies, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the National Development and Reform Commission, jointly issued the pharmaceutical industry's 15th Five-Year Plan. The plan directs accelerated deployment of frontier technologies and products and supports cross-disciplinary collaboration among drugmakers, universities, research institutes and hospitals. It calls for faster use of artificial intelligence, quantum computing, supercomputing and computational medicine in drug R&D; exploration of extreme manufacturing, space-based drug production and biomanufacturing for medical products; and deeper application of gene editing, precision molecular delivery, cell programming and control, advanced omics and next-generation brain–machine interfaces. Australian Dollar Attempts Rebound — The Australian dollar rose above $0.71, attempting to recover from a recent four-week low as hawkish comments from the Reserve Bank’s top official reinforced expectations for further policy tightening. Governor Michele Bullock said upside inflation risks were materializing and warned that higher costs could make inflation more persistent, pointing to rising energy prices and continued capacity pressures in the domestic economy. Her remarks follow statements over the past month by senior RBA officials that inflation remains elevated and needs to ease further. Swaps markets now priced at least two more rate hikes by the February meeting, with a roughly 87% chance the first occurs on September 29. That marks a notable shift from the start of September, when traders were pricing just one further hike, likely by year-end. The Aussie also benefited from a softer US dollar, alongside lower Treasury yields and easing oil prices, while a rebound in global equities improved risk sentiment.

【Trump's détente with KEVIN WARSH after rate hike may fray if Fed tightens again】Wall Street Journal senior Fed reporter Nick Timiraos reports Trump — a persistent critic of what he calls ‘too-high’ rates — said he approved this week’s Fed rate increase after a phone call with Fed chair KEVIN WARSH. Silver Holds Gains on Lower Oil Prices — Silver held above $65 an ounce on Friday after climbing more than 3% in the previous session, supported by falling oil prices that eased inflation concerns and helped push bond yields lower. Oil prices declined for a third consecutive session as Saudi Arabia worked to restore flows through its East-West pipeline, while President Donald Trump is set to meet with Gulf leaders next week. Treasury yields also pulled back from multi-year highs, with the US 10-year yield falling to around 4.93% after briefly exceeding 5% earlier this week. Meanwhile, investors continued to assess the outlook for Federal Reserve monetary policy following its first rate hike in three years. The US central bank signaled that additional tightening could be needed to contain inflationary pressures, with markets now pricing in roughly a 53% probability of a move in October.

【CITIC Securities: gas-turbine industry in new upcycle】CITIC Securities says the gas-turbine industry is in a new upcycle. Demand for small- and mid-sized turbines is rising faster owing to flexible deployment and shorter construction cycles. Overseas OEM capacity expansion has long lead times, keeping supply tight; bottlenecks in hot-end components and large rotating parts are transmitting upstream. Overseas supply gaps and constrained deliveries of core engines for aviation fuel reform are likely to shift demand to domestic complete-machine and component makers, boosting demand for upstream materials such as high-temperature alloys.

Japan Food Prices Rise the Least in 25 Months — Japan’s food prices rose 3.1% year-on-year in August 2026, slowing from 3.5% in the previous month and marking the slowest increase since July 2024. Price pressures moderated across fresh vegetables (5.5% vs 6.5% in July), fresh fruit (0.1% vs 2.4%), dairy products and eggs (1.3% vs 3.5%), cakes and candies (5.0% vs 6.1%), meats (3.3% vs 3.9%), alcoholic beverages (0.4% vs 0.6%), and prepared foods (3.3% vs 3.5%). Meanwhile, cereal prices fell for a fourth straight month (-3.4% vs -2.2%). At the same time, rice prices dropped 15.7% year-on-year, extending their decline for a fourth consecutive month and marking the steepest fall since April 2005. In contrast, prices accelerated for fish and seafood (9.9% vs 9.0%), oils, fats and seasonings (4.0% vs 3.4%), beverages (6.0% vs 5.5%), and meals eaten out (2.1% vs 1.7%).

【Huatai Securities: Big three airlines' August load factors strong; sector rebound awaits oil-price decline】Huatai Securities reports that in August peak travel the big three carriers (Air China, China Eastern, China Southern) plus Spring Airlines and Juneyao saw ASK +5.2% YoY and RPK +7.6% YoY; load factor rose 2ppt to a record 88.8% and ticket pricing showed some improvement. However, July–August domestic fares including fuel surcharges rose only 1.0% YoY—extreme weather and demand/capacity mismatches limited pricing and weakened oil-price pass-through. Huatai says a sector rebound will await lower oil prices; monitor high-frequency Mid-Autumn and National Day travel data. It expects cautious capacity deployment in Q4, which could support YoY revenue performance, and remains constructive on a mid-to-long-term recovery in the transport sector.

US Futures Steady After Upbeat Session — US stock futures were little changed on Friday after the major averages rallied in the previous session, as falling oil prices and bond yields improved risk appetite. In regular trading on Thursday, the Dow rose 0.61%, the S&P 500 gained 1.14%, and the Nasdaq Composite advanced 1.69%. Chipmakers led the gains, extending their recovery after concerns over AI safety earlier in the week sparked doubts about AI-related capital spending. Strong performances came from Micron (5.5%), Nvidia (2.5%), Intel (7.7%), AMD (6.4%), and SanDisk (6.2%). Stocks benefited from lower oil prices that eased inflation worries and helped Treasuries rally across the curve, with the US 10-year yield falling to around 4.93% after topping 5% earlier this week. Wall Street also rallied in relief after the Federal Reserve delivered a widely expected rate hike, though policymakers signaled further tightening to curb inflation.

【澳聯儲主席布洛克：政策會議前，抑制通脹是核心】澳洲聯儲主席米歇爾・布洛克在聽證會上表示，一週多後的議息會議上，澳聯儲理事會將評估當前已實施的貨幣緊縮政策，是否足以在合理時間內令通脹回落至目標區間。布洛克稱，儘管高利率給揹負房貸、同時面臨生活成本壓力的人群帶來負擔，但抑制通脹至關重要。貨幣政策具備應對形勢變化的空間，澳聯儲的核心任務是維護物價穩定與充分就業。澳聯儲下一次貨幣政策決議預計將於9月29日公佈。

【經濟日報金觀平：評判投資成效不能僅看增速高低】文章指出，今年前8個月，全國固定資產投資同比下降7.2%，降幅繼續擴大。對投資增速變化帶來的壓力，不必迴避，穩投資相關政策舉措也正在積極推進。同時更要看到，我國已進入高質量發展階段，發展邏輯、產業結構、投資內涵都發生了深刻變化，單一增速指標已不足以完整反映投資的真實狀況。評判投資成效，既要看速度，更要看結構、質量和效益，樹立起與高質量發展相匹配的評價標尺。
【高盛：仍維持2027年末金價每盎司5400美元的預測】高盛稱，儘管美聯儲昨日加息，我們仍維持2027年末金價每盎司5400美元的預測。各國央行持續的儲備多元化仍是我們看多黃金觀點的主要結構性驅動因素。我們預計金價仍存在上行淨風險，但過程中雙向波動性也會加劇。金價或先下探至每盎司4070美元的近期底部，隨後逐步回升，到2026年底觸及每盎司4200美元。
【中信證券：在美聯儲面臨持續加息風險的情況下，中國債券、大宗商品和低估值權益等資產更值得關注】中信證券研報認為，通脹的“實質性改善”和通脹壓力不擴散可能是美聯儲停止加息的兩大前提，這意味著美聯儲加息程序不會戛然而止，部分投資者對9月“鴿派加息”的預期並不成立，9月加息落地也不應被視作利空出盡。在美聯儲面臨持續加息風險的情況下，中國債券、大宗商品和低估值權益等具有安全性和確定性的資產更值得關注。

【日本通脹率四個月來首次回落 日本央行即將公佈利率決策】日本通脹率四個月來首次回落，主要反映政府補貼的影響。在消費者價格(CPI)資料公佈數小時後，日本央行將公佈利率決策。日本政府週五公佈，8月不含生鮮食品的CPI同比上漲1.7%，低於7月的1.8%。經濟學家此前預計漲幅持平。作為日本央行密切關注的通脹指標，剔除生鮮食品和能源的CPI同比上漲1.9%。整體CPI亦上漲1.9%。接受媒體調查的經濟學家一致預計，日本央行週五將加息25個基點至1.25%。這將是該央行三個月內第二次加息，緊縮步伐勢創1990年以來最快。

【中信建投：歐洲天然氣價格持續走高 LNG售價或維持高位】中信建投證券研報稱，歐洲天然氣價格持續上漲，2026年9月10日，荷蘭天然氣期貨結算價升至82歐元/兆瓦時，同比增長147.7%，環比增長14.3%。歐洲天然氣價格持續走高主要受美伊衝突持續，霍爾木茲海峽輸運受阻等因素的影響。在庫存方面，歐洲近期天然氣庫存水平約為65.83%，同比下降約12.7個百分點，系近年來最低水平。伴隨冬季採暖季的到來，歐盟較為剛性的補庫需求或推動歐亞LNG價格進一步上行。

【DoubleLine的Gundlach警告：下一次美國經濟衰退可能引發財政危機】DoubleLine Capital執行長Jeffrey Gundlach警告稱，下一次美國經濟衰退可能會引發債務危機，導致長期國債收益率大幅上升 —— 這將與數十年來的傳統觀念相悖，即所謂債券在經濟困境時期可以充當避風港。這種情況可能會促使美聯儲和財政部採取非常規政策，例如再來一次扭轉操作央行購買長期債券，甚至進行債務重組。他表示，他正專注於低久期資產，以保護Doubleline的基金免受利率進一步上升的影響。“如果出現經濟衰退，財政狀況將會受到極大的關注。”Gundlach在紐約的活動上說道，“預算赤字很容易達到GDP的12%。那將導致每年3萬億美元的利息支出，這是絕對不能接受的。”

【債市提前押注美聯儲持續加息 日元套利交易加速退潮】當地時間9月16日，美聯儲宣佈加息25個基點。儘管此次加息已被市場充分預期，屬於“確認式加息”，但債市最新定價已提前計入後續持續加息的緊縮預期。美國加息落地後，全球發達經濟體債市呈現“短端漲、長端穩”的走勢，這一變化正加速日元套利交易退潮，並推高新興市場融資成本。
【消費金融公司“貸”動智慧家居消費】近日，商務部等8部門印發《促進智慧家居消費行動方案》，其中提出，引導金融機構加大對智慧家居消費等貸款支援力度，積極支援消費者購買智慧家居相關產品。記者獲悉，2026年以來，持牌消費金融公司已運用場景分期、線上消費貸、貼息等方式，依託多元場景承接居民消費需求。（證券日報）

【鎢價暴漲後深度回撥 概念股上半年業績集體高增】鎢價經歷年初衝高、二季度大幅回撥後，三季度轉入高位窄幅震盪。雖然當前價格較3月曆史高點顯著回撥，但相比兩年前漲幅仍接近2倍。受國內開採配額管控，鎢供給增長空間有限，在戰略金屬屬性加持下鎢價格中樞仍有支撐。A股市場鎢礦概念股共計6只，隨著鎢價持續高位執行，產業鏈企業盈利能力大幅釋放，上半年板塊業績集體迎來爆發。從淨利潤規模看，洛陽鉬業、廈門鎢業、中鎢高新排名前三，依次為161.52億元、22.01億元、20.76億元；章源鎢業、翔鷺鎢業、中稀有色歸母淨利潤也超過4億元。從淨利潤變動看，翔鷺鎢業、章源鎢業、中稀有色、中鎢高新、廈門鎢業上半年歸母淨利潤均同比翻倍增長。翔鷺鎢業最高，增幅高達2522.40%；章源鎢業、中稀有色隨後，增幅均在400%以上。

【AI熱潮蔓延至金剛石散熱賽道 超硬材料企業跨界搶灘】人工智慧（AI）熱潮正蔓延到金剛石散熱賽道。近幾個月來，多家傳統超硬材料上市公司密集釋出投資及募投變更公告，紛紛切入金剛石散熱賽道。證券時報記者瞭解到，隨著相關專案先後落地，部分上市公司金剛石散熱產品已經進入送樣、小批次供貨階段。當前伴隨AI大模型迭代帶動伺服器晶片功耗持續走高，傳統銅鋁散熱材料逐步觸碰物理效能天花板，CVD金剛石熱沉被視作破解高功率晶片散熱痛點的關鍵材料。在培育鑽石、工業金剛石主業價格低迷、企業盈利承壓的背景下，向半導體功能材料轉型，成為超硬材料行業企業的現實選擇。

【供應擔憂緩解、伊朗外交取得進展，油價下跌】原油價格連續第三日走低，市場對供應的憂慮有所緩和，交易員聚焦將影響美伊戰爭走向的新一輪外交磋商。西德克薩斯中質原油（WTI）回落至每桶 101 美元附近，前兩個交易日累計下跌近 4%；布倫特原油收於每桶 105 美元下方。中東方面，沙特正著手修復受損的東西輸油管道，該管道通往紅海沿岸，計劃在數日之內恢復約一半輸送能力。與此同時，部分油輪仍在穿越局勢緊張的霍爾木茲海峽。美國總統唐納德・特朗普表示，他即將作出一項 “重大決定”，判斷是否升級對德黑蘭的打擊行動。下週他將在紐約聯合國大會期間，與波斯灣國家舉行場外會晤。10 月交割的 WTI 原油下跌 0.8%，報每桶 101.12 美元。11 月交割的布倫特原油下跌 1%，收於每桶 104.82 美元。

【國際金價坐上“過山車” 多因素仍支撐中長期黃金配置】全球黃金市場在美聯儲議息結果公佈前後經歷了戲劇性的一幕。在當地時間9月16日美聯儲利率決議公佈前，國際金價一度衝高至4360美元/盎司上方，日內漲幅逾1%；在加息“靴子”落地後，金價迅速跳水，最終收跌0.7%至4263.13美元/盎司，為近四周低位。黃金不生息的特性，在利率上行環境中再次暴露其脆弱的一面。A股貴金屬板塊同樣反應劇烈。北京時間9月17日，該板塊領跌，收跌超過5%。然而當日亞歐交易時段，倫敦現貨黃金價格卻震盪攀升，重新站上4300美元/盎司。截至記者發稿時，倫敦金報4326.9美元/盎司，漲1.5%。市場原本預期這會是一次“鴿派”加息，實際落地時卻亮出“鷹爪”——美聯儲不僅時隔三年多首次加息，還釋放出年內或進一步收緊貨幣政策的訊號。受訪人士認為，金價仍以區間震盪為主，短期走強可視為利空出盡，中期美國財政壓力和美元信用擔憂等仍支撐黃金配置。（上海證券報）

Brent Slides for Third Session — Brent crude fell to around $104 per barrel on Friday, extending its decline for a third consecutive session as concerns over supply disruptions in the Middle East eased and hopes grew for renewed diplomatic efforts to end the conflict and restore energy flows. Saudi Arabia is targeting the recovery of around half the capacity of its East-West pipeline within days, with a return to full operations expected within six weeks. In the meantime, the kingdom is rerouting some crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz. Shuttle vessels transport crude through Hormuz before loading tankers waiting outside the strait, limiting their exposure to potential Iranian attacks. Reports also suggested that China had urged Iran to help curb Houthi militants after an appeal from Riyadh, as the rebel group intensified attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump said he was weighing whether to resume attacks on Iran ahead of a meeting with Gulf leaders in New York next week.

【8000億元新型政策性金融工具資金加快投放】近日，今年新型政策性金融工具首批資金已啟動投放，一批智慧製造和基礎設施專案相繼獲得首批資金支援，正加快推進實施，推動擴大有效投資。新型政策性金融工具是國家為支援重大戰略、補充重點專案資本金而創設的金融工具，透過資本金槓桿放大投資總量，最佳化投資結構，由國家開發銀行、農業發展銀行、進出口銀行負責投放。目前，新型政策性金融工具已在雲南、福建、四川等多地加快投放，今年的總投資規模從去年的5000億元增加到8000億元，據測算，預計將撬動專案總投資規模約10萬億元。（央視新聞）

【 美駐墨西哥使館以“墨西哥萬歲，中國製造”調侃墨西哥國慶，中使館發表嚴正宣告 】 9月18日，中國駐墨西哥大使館發表嚴正宣告：9月15日，墨西哥獨立日前夕，美國駐墨西哥使館在社交媒體平臺發文，稱墨西哥用於慶祝活動的煙花等“並非墨西哥製造”，以“墨西哥萬歲，中國製造”調侃墨西哥國慶，並藉機抹黑中墨經貿合作。在駐在國最莊嚴的國慶紀念日，一國使館不思道賀，反而拿節日大做文章、攻擊第三國。此舉有違最基本的外交禮儀，更缺乏對墨西哥人民起碼的尊重。中國駐墨西哥使館對此表示強烈不滿和堅決反對。一國獨立日屬於該國人民，如何慶祝、用什麼慶祝，人民自己說了算。“中國製造”在墨西哥並不新鮮。四百多年前，“中國船”讓東方的絲綢瓷器與墨西哥的白銀在太平洋兩岸間流動，商品往來的背後是文明的交流互鑑。今天，中國產品走進墨西哥市場，墨西哥的牛油果、龍舌蘭酒也走進中國千家萬戶，緊密的貿易聯絡正是全球化的生動體現。一個主權獨立的國家，有權自主選擇合作伙伴。中墨合作沒有地緣算計，不針對第三方，也不應受到第三方干擾。美使館把駐在國的節日當作攻擊第三國的舞臺和地緣博弈的籌碼，對別國指手畫腳，唯我獨尊的霸權心態暴露無遺。此等做法，國際社會看得一清二楚。不少網友質問美方，為何要在別人的節日裡“噴灑毒液”。我們奉勸美國駐墨西哥使館，把精力多用在尊重駐在國、增進兩國人民友好上，而不是挑撥離間、搬弄是非。這樣的表演騙不了任何人，只會搬起石頭砸自己的腳。

【科創債從試水走向定製 創投募資生態正在重構】近期，國內創投機構積極發行科創債，條款設計上創新不斷，超長期限人工智慧產業鏈科創債、可交換條款科創債、定向發行科創債等新型產品陸續落地，債券市場正透過多元化機制適配硬科技投資的長週期屬性。在科創債助力創投機構緩解資金壓力、支撐長期科創投資的同時，行業也面臨著資負期限錯配、民營機構發債門檻高、增信渠道不暢等現實難題。專家表示，科創債的市場化創新仍需持續深化，透過完善增信機制、豐富產品體系、培育投資生態，進一步打通債券市場服務科技創新的資金通道。（中國證券報）

【墨西哥總統辛鮑姆與特朗普通話，雙方持續磋商貿易事宜】多名知情人士透露，墨西哥總統克勞迪婭・辛鮑姆與美國總統特朗普通電話，討論雙邊貿易問題。此次通話於週三進行。美墨兩國官員正開展貿易談判，希望解決美國關稅、墨西哥出口產品原產地規則等多項懸而未決的爭議。此次通話發生在上月底美加貿易談判破裂之後。特朗普週三在一場競選活動中暗示，美墨貿易談判有望取得突破性進展，稱一份“重大協議”即將達成。白宮未回應置評請求。其中一名訊息人士稱，美墨談判代表的下一輪貿易會談預計將於9月28日在華盛頓啟動。

【中國新任駐澳大利亞大使劉勁松向莫斯廷總督遞交國書】9月16日，中國新任駐澳大利亞大使劉勁松前往澳總督府，向澳總督莫斯廷遞交國書，雙方進行了親切友好的交流。澳外交貿易部副秘書長艾麗，使館李繁傑公使、邱旭強武官、高睿參贊等參加。莫斯廷總督請劉大使轉達對習近平主席的親切問候。莫斯廷總督特別就中國西藏吉隆泥石流災害向中方表示誠摯慰問，感謝中方為搜救澳失聯人員所作努力。莫斯廷總督愉快地憶及40年前訪華情形，積極評價中國發展進步和澳中關係進展，表示澳方將為劉大使履職提供便利和支援，建議劉大使多去澳各地走走看看。莫斯廷總督還與劉大使就體育等話題輕鬆聊天。

【新華社：中國“十五五”規劃，為世界提供新機遇】今年是“十五五”開局之年。“十五五”規劃綱要既為中國發展擘畫藍圖，也向世界發出合作邀約。——中國大市場擴容升級，將為促進全球發展繁榮創造新的機遇。市場是當今世界的稀缺資源。14億多人口的超大規模市場，是中國的，也是世界的。——深化產業鏈供應鏈合作，將為全球經濟發展注入新的動能。創新是經濟發展的重要內生動力。中國始終以積極的姿態融入國際創新和產業分工體系，共同維護全球產供鏈穩定暢通，為世界經濟發展注入強大“向新力”。——持續最佳化外商投資環境，將為各國在華投資興業拓展新的空間。“十五五”期間，中國將以實際行動兌現開放的承諾，敞開共贏的大門，為外商在華投資創造更多新的機遇：降低“進”的門檻。推動電信、網際網路、教育、文化、醫療等領域有序擴大開放，穩妥實施增值電信、生物技術、外商獨資醫院等開放試點，推進服務業擴大開放綜合試點示範。高質量共建“一帶一路”，將為開創合作共贏新局面凝聚新的合力。中國經濟是一片大海，蘊藏著無限的潛能。面向未來，一個內需潛力持續釋放、向新向優動能不斷集聚、高水平開放向縱深推進的中國，將持續為世界發展提供新機遇。

Costa Rica Unemployment Rate Falls to 7.0% in Q2 — The unemployment rate in Costa Rica fell to 7.0% in the second quarter of 2026 from 7.4% in the same period a year earlier, but little changed from 7.1% in the previous quarter. Nationwide, the number of unemployed people was estimated at 164,000, including 98,000 men and 66,000 women. The unemployment rate was 6.8% for men and 7.2% for women. The labor force stood at 2.35 million, comprising 1.43 million men and 921,000 women, while the net labor force participation rate was 54.6%, at 66.3% for men and 42.9% for women. Employment rose to 2.18 million, with the employment rate at 50.8%, compared with 61.7% for men and 39.8% for women. Informal employment totaled 785,000, including 438,000 self-employed workers and 348,000 wage earners or family helpers.
【外圍擾動不改市場長期趨勢 基金公司看好A股韌性】北京時間9月17日凌晨，美聯儲宣佈將聯邦基金利率目標區間上調25個基點。這場此前被市場預判為偏向“鴿派”的加息，最終釋放偏“鷹”訊號，令市場爭論再起。多家基金公司判斷，此次美聯儲的貨幣緊縮政策，帶來的或是短期擾動，疊加國內貨幣政策具有獨立性，且A股基本面具備支撐，長期可保持樂觀，當下可採取“科技+紅利”的槓鈴配置思路。（上海證券報）

【國泰海通：成品油輪未來數年供給剛性 高景氣持續性有望超預期】國泰海通釋出研報稱，成品油輪未來數年供給剛性，高景氣持續性有望超預期，建議增持。成品油輪船東自2023年率先批次下單，隨後數年景氣波動影響下單持續性。目前成品油輪在手訂單佔比22%，仍處歷史偏低水平。目前20歲以上老船已超20%，未來三年將再有近20%超20歲。目前在手訂單僅保障未來數年主流市場合規運力規模平穩，而船廠訂單已排期至2030年之後，船臺緊張將保障未來數年成品油運供給剛性。亞洲貿易恢復與補庫將驅動成品油運短期景氣快速上升，全球煉廠東移與貿易加速重構將保障中長期高景氣可持續，提供業績估值雙重空間。
【國泰海通：石化供應恢復延遲疊加庫存持續去化 Q4油價易漲難跌】國泰海通釋出研報稱，8月國際油價整體上行，地緣擾動加劇，全球庫存持續去化。Q4供應預期進一步下修，地緣風險及低庫存對油價形成支撐，但高油價對需求的負反饋逐步顯現。三大機構預計需求預測分歧，IEA和EIA預計2026需求下滑，OPEC預計維持增長。油價偏強震盪，推薦上游的公司，以及受益替代路線的公司。

New Zealand Equities Head for Weekly Gain — The NZX 50 advanced 29 points, or 0.2%, to 13,785 in Friday morning trade, up for the third straight session, tracking gains on Wall Street overnight as easing oil prices softened Treasury yields, while the Fed’s rate hike reaffirmed the central bank’s commitment to contain inflation. Thursday’s data continued to lift sentiment after New Zealand’s GDP grew faster than expected in Q2. However, traders awaited China’s interest rate decision and US PMI data next week for clues about the economic outlook in the two countries. On the data front, New Zealand’s trade deficit narrowed in August from July, as exports rose more than imports, while food inflation stayed at a 19-month low. Real estate, consumer discretionary, and financials mainly drove the index, with notable gains including Port of Tauranga (1.0%), Chorus (0.8%), Hallenstein Glasson (0.8%), and Auckland International Airport (0.5%).

New Zealand Food Inflation Stays at 19-Month Low — Annual food inflation in New Zealand stood at 1.9% in August 2026, unchanged from the previous month, which was the softest increase since December 2024. Prices for meat, poultry, and fish increased by 3.4% (vs 3.2% in July), after marking the slowest rate since at least June 2025 in July, and remained the largest contributor to the annual increase in food prices. Grocery food prices also accelerated (1.7% vs 1.6% in July), while fruit and vegetable prices fell at a faster rate, declining 1.6%, following a 1.0% drop in July.

【韓國將燃油稅減免政策延長至 11 月底】韓國財政部週五表示，將把燃油稅減免措施再度延長兩個月，執行至 11 月底。 財政部稱，為緩解中東局勢引發油價波動帶來的燃油成本壓力，將繼續維持汽油 15%、柴油與丁烷 25% 的燃油稅減免幅度。

New Zealand Imports Climbs 13% in August — Imports to New Zealand rose 13.1% year-on-year to NZD 8.0 billion in August 2026, following a 28.4% jump in the previous month. The increase in imports was mainly driven by higher purchases of petroleum and petroleum products (up 43%), vehicles, parts, and accessories (up 30%), electrical machinery and equipment (up 25%), and mechanical machinery and equipment (up 15%).

【富國銀行建議拋售日元 指日本央行或令鷹派失望】富國銀行建議在日本央行做出決定前賣出日元兌美元，因為它不太可能達到甚至超過鷹派的市場預期。“我們仍然懷疑日本央行能比市場已經隱含的激進緊縮路徑更鷹派，” 亞太宏觀策略主管Chidu Narayanan在一份報告中寫道。市場預期已隱含在2027年7月之前，每隔一次會議都將加息25個基點。“日本央行要滿足這些預期的門檻很高，要超越更難”。建議買入美元/日元，目標位159，止損位在153.40。

【地方補貼疊加車企促銷，釋放汽車消費潛能】為擴大汽車消費，9月份以來，多地啟動了新一輪汽車消費補貼活動。例如，青島市商務局釋出的《“2026禮惠金秋”新車消費補貼活動實施細則》顯示，自2026年9月10日起開展“2026禮惠金秋”新車消費補貼活動，市級財政安排資金5000萬元，資金額度用完即為活動結束；據漳州市商務局官網披露，9月11日至12月31日，該市開展2026年新一輪汽車促消費補貼活動，統籌620萬元財政資金髮放補貼名額，先到先得，用完即止；南京市商務局在微信公眾號釋出的訊息顯示，9月16日至12月31日，南京市組織各區開展第二輪汽車購新促消費活動。本輪地方推出的汽車消費補貼活動，有的只針對新車購置，並且按照新能源汽車、燃油汽車兩個類別確定補貼標準；有的還將二手車購置納入補貼範圍，針對新車、二手車分別設定了不同檔位的補貼標準。（證券日報）

【Yemen government forces, Houthi fighters clash near Bab al-Mandeb】Yemen government and Houthi officials said on the 17th that heavy fighting has raged over the past 24 hours near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait for high ground overlooking the strategic shipping lane. An anonymous government officer said fighting since the 16th has concentrated in the Kahbub highlands and surrounding heights in southern Lahij province, with Houthis launching a new offensive against government defences; the officer said fighting began overnight and has not stopped. At least 19 government soldiers have been killed and 15 wounded; the wounded were taken to a military hospital in Aden. A Houthi official, speaking anonymously, said the front remains deadlocked, several commanding heights have changed hands multiple times and at least 25 Houthi fighters have been killed with others wounded.

【中國民航局：推動人工智慧規模化落地、常態化應用】以“人工智慧與民航融合發展”為主題的第四屆中國航協航空大會正在北京舉行。大會上，中國民航局相關負責人介紹說，中國民航局已印發實施推進“人工智慧+民航”高質量發展指導意見，要推動人工智慧從概念探索、技術試驗轉向規模化落地、常態化應用。據介紹，民航場景豐富多元、資料資源密集，天然具備人工智慧落地應用的沃土。在機場端，重點推進大型樞紐機場智慧資源排程、機位智慧分配、執行態勢智慧研判、旅客全流程智慧出行服務，大幅提升樞紐執行效率和旅客出行體驗。在航空公司端，依託智慧演算法最佳化機組排班、航班動態調整、飛機智慧維修、航油精細管控，全面提升航司執行精細化水平。在航空物流領域，加快推進貨站作業、倉儲分揀、通關保障全鏈條智慧化改造，破解物流週轉效率瓶頸。（央視新聞）

【中小股東提案門檻要“降”，行權通道更要“暢”】新《公司法》將股東臨時提案持股門檻降至1%，至今已一年有餘，然而門檻下降並未明顯啟用中小股東的提案熱情。中小股東提案少，並非投資者沒有訴求。近兩年多場上市公司股東會上，關聯交易、股權激勵、修訂規則等方案遭遇中小股東高票反對，部分議案在大股東迴避表決後直接被否決。這說明，中小投資者對公司經營、利益分配有著清晰判斷，參與公司治理的意願持續高漲。可現實是，很多中小股東的合理訴求難以轉化為正式提案，制度供給與實際行權之間仍存在落差。行權成本高是第一道現實門檻。股東行使臨時提案權，需單獨或合計持有1%股份。對於分散股東而言，想要聯合湊齊這一持股比例，會面臨股東資訊隔離、聯絡渠道匱乏等難題，且自發聯合的時間成本、溝通成本高昂。即便湊夠持股條件，相關提案還需要具備清晰議題、可付諸表決的決議事項。普通投資者大多不熟悉相關規則，又缺少專業中介力量支援，不少提案因為格式、文字等形式瑕疵，直接被董事會擋在股東會之外。（證券時報）

New Zealand Balance Trade Gap Below Estimates — New Zealand's trade deficit widened to NZD 1.35 billion in August 2026, up slightly from a NZD 1.31 billion gap in the same month a year earlier but below estimates of a NZD 1.78 billion gap. 【UNGA adopts resolution allowing State of Palestine to participate in 81st session via video】On Sept. 17 the UN General Assembly adopted a resolution on participation arrangements for the State of Palestine during the 81st UNGA session, permitting President Mahmoud Abbas and other Palestinian representatives to participate via videoconference or pre-recorded statements after the United States refused to grant visas to Abbas and some officials. The draft passed 152-3-4; China voted in favor. The resolution expressed regret at the US decision to deny or revoke Palestinian representatives’ visas, urged their immediate reversal, and reaffirmed that State of Palestine representatives should be entitled to attend relevant meetings in person at UN headquarters in New York.

【聯大透過決議 允許巴勒斯坦總統以影片方式參加第81屆聯大】當地時間9月17日，聯合國大會透過一項有關巴勒斯坦國在第81屆聯大會議期間與會安排的決議，在美國拒絕向巴勒斯坦總統阿巴斯及部分巴勒斯坦官員發放簽證的背景下，聯大決定允許巴勒斯坦方面透過視訊會議或預先錄製發言等方式參與有關聯合國會議。決議草案獲得152票支援，3票反對，4票棄權；中方投了贊成票。根據決議，大會對美國在第81屆聯大會議召開前拒發或吊銷巴勒斯坦國代表簽證表示遺憾，敦促立即撤銷相關決定。決議指出，巴勒斯坦國代表理應能夠親自參加在紐約聯合國總部舉行的相關會議。（央視新聞）

【亞馬遜加入AI安全討論 呼籲模型釋出前嚴格測試】亞馬遜表示，人工智慧模型只有在經過嚴格測試後才應釋出。在多家頂尖AI實驗室因安全漏洞呼籲放慢開發速度後，該公司也加入了有關AI發展步伐的討論。“我們並不認為進步與安全之間只能二選一，”亞馬遜發言人Tom Parnell在電子郵件中表示。“模型應當在準備就緒並能夠安全使用時才釋出，而這需要嚴格測試和強有力的防護措施。如果不能共同做到這一點，就會存在風險。我們相信，作為一個行業，在與政府合作之下，我們將共同確立恰當的保護措施。”亞馬遜是多家領先AI公司的合作伙伴和投資者，其中包括OpenAI和Anthropic PBC。這些公司的高管已呼籲放慢尖端AI的開發步伐，以評估這項技術的安全性。

【“月付退出支付選項”系誤讀，記者實測：收銀臺頁面正在“分家”】近日，“平臺月付將退出支付選項”登上微博熱搜，相關話題不斷髮酵，引發消費者對選擇支付方式的疑問：以後花唄、美團月付、京東白條等產品不能用於線上付款了？日前，記者從支付寶、京東、美團等多家平臺客服處瞭解到，月付類產品仍可正常使用，且平臺會遵照監管規定對收銀臺頁面的展示方式進行調整。業內人士分析稱，上述熱搜中的說法是對《金融產品網路營銷管理辦法》第十二條規定的誤讀。新規並非禁止貸款類產品用於支付，而是強調要將此類產品與銀行卡、賬戶餘額等基礎支付工具區隔展示，從源頭上治理支付環節誘導借貸、“無感借貸”等亂象。（中證報）

【科創債從試水走向定製，創投募資生態正在重構】近期，國內創投機構積極發行科創債，條款設計上創新不斷，超長期限人工智慧產業鏈科創債、可交換條款科創債、定向發行科創債等新型產品陸續落地，債券市場正透過多元化機制適配硬科技投資的長週期屬性。在科創債助力創投機構緩解資金壓力、支撐長期科創投資的同時，行業也面臨著資負期限錯配、民營機構發債門檻高、增信渠道不暢等現實難題。專家表示，科創債的市場化創新仍需持續深化，透過完善增信機制、豐富產品體系、培育投資生態，進一步打通債券市場服務科技創新的資金通道。（中證報）

【Anthropic披露AI發展指標：Claude主導公司26%研發 參與約90%工作】Anthropic PBC表示，該公司超過四分之一的人工智慧研發工作由Claude聊天機器人主導，這為AI能夠幫助加快未來模型開發提供了迄今最明確的跡象。根據Anthropic週四釋出的報告，Claude“主導”該公司26%的研發，而今年年初這一比例幾乎為零。這家AI開發商表示，Claude還參與協助員工約90%的工作。這些資料是Anthropic更廣泛報告的一部分。隨著外界日益擔憂AI可能迅速提升自身能力並脫離人類控制，該報告旨在幫助公眾追蹤AI的發展進展。該公司還重申，計劃引入來自多家機構的第三方評估人員，並向其授予與本公司員工同等的內部流程、系統及資料訪問許可權。“AI系統正以指數級速度變得更加強大，並已開始將更多構建自身的過程自動化。隨著全球考慮放慢前沿AI的開發速度，公眾需要獲得更多資訊，”該公司寫道。

【Trump considers meeting Venezuela interim president at UN General Assembly】Trump is considering meeting Venezuela’s interim president Delcy Rodriguez as early as next week during the UN General Assembly in New York, Axios reports. A US official says the meeting is not finalized and depends on Trump; the president has said he might meet her. Rodriguez, who assumed power after predecessor Maduro was reportedly captured in a US military operation, has worked with the Trump administration and Secretary of State Rubio on normalizing US‑Venezuela ties, including a previously reported large Venezuelan oil deal. Trump plans to discuss Iran with Gulf leaders at the UN; his team is reportedly prioritizing energy prices and immigration over pushing Venezuelan elections.

Brent Extends Drop as Supply Risks Ease — Brent crude oil settled near $104 a barrel on Thursday, extending a 2.7% drop from the previous session, as Saudi Arabia shifts some crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz to offset the closure of a key pipeline. Saudi Arabia is reportedly making additional crude cargoes available to Asian refiners through ship-to-ship transfers near Oman’s Sohar port. Shuttle vessels transport crude through Hormuz before loading tankers waiting outside the strait, reducing their exposure to Iranian attacks. Saudi Arabia also said it could restore around half of the damaged East-West pipeline’s capacity within days and full operations within six weeks. Saudi crude loadings at Mideast Gulf ports have risen this month, while ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman increased to 2.7 million bpd from 1.5 million bpd in August. Meanwhile, Russia’s seaborne oil product exports jumped 16.4% in August from July as refineries returned from maintenance.

【Container freight rates may retest pandemic highs as Middle East conflict lifts fuel costs】Conflict involving Iran has pushed fuel costs higher and driven global container rates up. Xeneta data show spot freight for a 40ft box on a major deep-sea route at $10,948, more than four times its level since the Feb. 28 outbreak and nearing the $11,900 record of Jan. 2022. Low-sulfur marine fuel has risen to $901.5/ton from $543.5 on Feb. 27, though still below the $1,053 peak on Mar. 20. With firms accelerating restocking ahead of the seasonal peak, demand could push rates higher; Xeneta analysts say persistent fuel surcharges leave a return above the pandemic peak possible.

【受中東衝突影響 集裝箱運價或再創疫情後新高】伊朗戰爭導致燃油成本上漲，全球集裝箱航運價格持續攀升，分析人士稱，部分主要航線運價可能再次接近或突破疫情期間創下的歷史高位。根據貨運定價平臺Xeneta資料，一條主要遠洋集裝箱航線40英尺集裝箱現貨運價已升至10948美元，較2月28日伊朗戰爭爆發以來上漲超過4倍，接近2022年1月創下的11900美元歷史紀錄。船用低硫燃油價格目前升至每噸901.5美元，而2月27日時為543.5美元，但仍低於3月20日創下的1053美元峰值。隨著傳統旺季前企業加快補充庫存，航運需求可能進一步推高運價。Xeneta分析師表示，在燃油附加費持續上漲的情況下，相關集裝箱航線運價不排除超過疫情時期峰值。

South Korea Producer Inflation Rises in August — South Korea’s producer prices rose 7.9% year over year in August 2026, accelerating from a 7.7% increase in July. Manufacturing producer prices climbed 12.2%, led by a 54.3% surge in coal and petroleum products. Prices for computers, electronic and optical equipment rose 24.5%, while chemical products increased 16.9% and basic metal products advanced 16.0%. Meanwhile, prices of agricultural, forestry, and marine products rose 1.1%, while service prices increased 4.4%. Utility prices rose 2.9%. In contrast, prices of mining products edged down 0.1%. On a monthly basis, the Producer Price Index increased 0.2%, following a 0.4% rise in July.

【ANTHROPIC releases metric system to track pace of frontier lab AI development】ANTHROPIC published a public metric framework to measure the pace of frontier lab AI development, aiming to give outsiders clearer data on model R&D progress. The framework targets three areas: AI participation in next‑generation AI R&D, supervisory control over AI agent behavior, and resource投入 into developing stronger models. It includes an AI R&D Automation Index that measures Claude’s share of company R&D. As of Aug 2026, Claude had not achieved fully autonomous R&D in any measured domain but accounted for about 26% of ANTHROPIC’s AI R&D; over 90% of R&D work reached ‘AI collaboration’ or higher.

Ibovespa Edges Higher After Selic Cut — The Ibovespa edged 0.2% higher to close at 185,992 on Thursday after a volatile session following the BCB’s decision to cut the Selic rate by 25 bps to 13.75%. The Copom did not signal its next steps but left the door open for another cut at the next meeting. The message was one of continuity, with monetary policy remaining cautious, data-dependent, and focused on composure. Still, the index fell as much as 1.2% during the session amid concerns over government spending and electoral effects after the federal government announced a 15% increase in welfare benefits. Polls showing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro numerically ahead in second-round scenarios continued to support the index. A halt in the oil rally and the consequent softening of global yields also helped support the market. Major banks were mixed, with Banco do Brasil rising 0.3% and Santander advancing 2.5%, while Itaú inched lower and Bradesco fell 0.3%. Vale rose 2.1%, helped by higher iron ore prices.

The employment rate edged up to 45.0% from 44.8%, while labor force participation increased to 48.9% from 48.6%. 【NBC: Pentagon weighing withdrawal of about 25,000 U.S. troops from Europe】NBC, citing seven current and former U.S. and Western officials, reports the Pentagon is assessing a significant drawdown of U.S. forces in Europe that could withdraw roughly 25,000 troops—about one-third of the roughly 80,000 currently stationed there—and could extend to as many as 40,000. The Pentagon launched a six-month review in June; an assessment is expected to be submitted to the defense secretary soon. Options under consideration include cuts to air, naval and ground personnel or relocation of some units. Officials say the review aims to align deployments with the "America First" strategy. Some European governments and U.S. lawmakers warn a large-scale withdrawal could weaken NATO deterrence; supporters argue for rebalancing overseas forces and shifting greater defense burden to European allies. No decision has been made; any withdrawal would require presidential approval.

Argentina GDP Growth Slows in Q2 — Argentina’s economy grew 2.0% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, slowing from a 2.3% increase in the previous quarter, but beating forecasts of a 1.6% expansion. The strongest sector gains came from fishing (44.7%), mining and quarrying (16.4%), and agriculture, livestock, hunting and forestry (6.9%). Other notable expansions were recorded in electricity, gas and water (5.0%), financial intermediation (4.8%), and hotels and restaurants (1.6%). In contrast, manufacturing contracted 2.1%, while public administration and defense declined 1.4%, marking the weakest performances. On the demand side, exports rose 13.7% year-on-year, leading growth, while private consumption increased 0.4% and public consumption fell 4.1%. Gross fixed capital formation contracted 11.1%, while imports of goods and services fell 8.6%. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, the economy contracted 0.6% in seasonally adjusted terms.

【摩根大通關於伊朗戰爭以何種方式結束：“我們根本不知道”】伊朗戰爭爆發六個多月後，摩根大通的石油分析師公開表達了許多交易員一段時間以來私下所說的看法：這場戰爭將以何種方式結束，正變得越來越難以預測。包括Natasha Kaneva在內的分析師在一份報告中表示，該行此前認為美國政府不願突破的幾條經濟紅線，包括油價升至每桶100美元以上、汽油價格逼近每加侖5美元以及美國國債收益率飆升，如今都已經出現，這使得退出戰略變得更加不明朗。隨著能源價格飆升，而由此產生的連鎖影響可能破壞全球經濟增長並加劇通脹，石油交易員和分析師越來越不確定伊朗戰爭還會持續多久。包括沙烏地阿拉伯至關重要的東西向輸油管道在內的關鍵能源基礎設施近期遭到襲擊，加劇了市場對供應進一步趨緊的擔憂。分析師們在週四被市場參與者廣泛援引的一份報告中表示：“我們認為，市場目前高度緊張。” 他們表示，9月份石油的合理價值估計約為每桶90美元，儘管目前價格接近106美元，並補充說，這意味著，在目前已經有每日1000萬桶供應受到干擾的基礎上，市場正在計入每日額外損失400萬桶供應的風險。

【US approves PEZESHKIAN and Iran foreign minister to attend UN General Assembly in New York】The U.S. State Department told AP it has approved travel for Iranian President PEZESHKIAN and Foreign Minister Araghchi to attend next week’s UN General Assembly high-level meetings in New York. The department said Iran’s core delegation and necessary staff will be allowed to participate but will face travel restrictions and a U.S. policy ban on purchasing luxury and other restricted items; the delegation will be smaller than last year. The decision comes after more than six months of U.S.-Iran conflict, with no material progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz or restarting Iran nuclear talks. As host of the UN, the U.S. is constrained by host-country obligations and has previously issued limited visas and activity curbs for representatives from conflict parties. The approval follows a separate U.S. visa denial for Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas one day earlier.

【中方強調維護伊核問題政治解決大局】當地時間9月17日上午，在聯合國安理會會議上，美國等國無視涉及伊朗核問題的第2231號決議已於2025年10月18日到期終止，安理會已終止審議伊朗核問題，在安理會強推恢復對伊朗制裁、提出明顯具有爭議的決議草案。中國和俄羅斯在對該草案的表決中投下反對票，巴基斯坦和索馬利亞投下棄權票，草案未獲透過。 中國常駐聯合國代表傅聰大使在表決後的解釋性發言中表示，中方從捍衛公道正義、維護中東地區和平穩定出發，著眼伊朗核問題政治外交解決大局，對決議草案投了反對票。 傅聰大使指出，形勢越是動盪，安理會越要展現領導力，以負責任態度採取行動，避免雙重標準、政治操弄、施壓對抗。 傅聰大使強調，軍事手段和制裁施壓無助於解決問題，只會加劇緊張，升級局勢不符合任何一方利益，平等對話談判才是唯一正途。 據瞭解，這一被否決的決議草案尋求將根據安理會第1929號決議（2010年）設立、將於9月26日屆滿的伊朗制裁委專家小組任期延長一年。該專家小組負責監督對伊朗制裁制度的執行情況。（CCTV國際時訊）

【摩根大通：根本不知道伊朗戰爭何時結束，經濟紅線已現】摩根大通石油分析師稱，“我們根本不知道” 伊朗戰爭何時結束  ，戰爭結束道路越來越難以預測。該行此前認為美國政府不會跨越的多條經濟紅線均已出現，包括油價突破每桶100美元、汽油價格接近每加侖5美元以及國債收益率飆升，令退出策略更不明朗。分析師娜塔莎·卡內瓦等人指出，油價目前接近每桶106美元，而9月原油合理價格估計約為每桶90美元，意味著市場正計入額外400萬桶/日的供應損失風險，此前已造成每日1000萬桶供應中斷。摩根大通稱，包括沙特東-西向輸油管道在內的關鍵能源基礎設施最近遭攻擊，加劇供應進一步緊張擔憂，市場情緒緊張。分析師認為，美國和伊朗均未發出準備緩和局勢的明確訊號，因此認為當前混亂只是暫時的假設越來越難以維持。

【羅馬尼亞總統今年第三次委任總理】布加勒斯特訊息：羅馬尼亞總統達恩17日宣佈，委任歐洲議會議員西格弗裡德·穆雷尚為新總理，這已是他今年第三次委任總理。 達恩當天在總統府與議會政黨進行磋商後召開新聞釋出會，宣佈他委任歐洲議會議員、國家自由黨成員穆雷尚為總理。隨後，穆雷尚在社交媒體上表示接受委任。 今年5月初，羅馬尼亞參眾兩院聯席會議投票透過對政府的不信任動議，時任總理博洛讓領導的政府下臺。6月4日，達恩委任他的顧問、歐洲議會議員歐金·托馬茨為總理，以期結束政府倒臺引發的政治危機。6月14日，歐金·托馬茨辭職後，達恩委任布拉索夫縣議會主席阿德里安·韋什泰亞為新總理。6月22日，羅馬尼亞參眾兩院聯席會議投票否決韋什泰亞的組閣方案，臨時政府繼續履職至今。(新華社)

【特朗普稱將決定是否恢復大規模作戰】據美國“阿克西奧斯新聞網（Axios）”當地時間9月17日報道，美國總統特朗普告訴該媒體，他正面臨對伊朗戰事的一個關鍵轉折點，需要決定是否重啟大規模攻勢，以期結束這場衝突。據報道，特朗普說，：“我即將作出一個重大決定。我要不要直接打過去把他們（伊朗政權）消滅掉？這將是個重大決定。我這邊什麼情況都可能發生。” Axios分析指出，特朗普計劃於下週在紐約聯合國大會間隙與六個海灣國家的領導人舉行會晤。這次會議可能會塑造戰爭的下一階段走向，包括是再次推動外交解決，還是升級軍事行動。如果特朗普想要恢復大規模作戰，他需要得到地區盟友的同意。 特朗普最近幾天多次表示，戰爭很快就會結束。但一些美國官員警告稱，美伊之間已陷入一種不可持續的“非戰非和”僵局。他們認為，如果遲遲未達成協議，特朗普可能會在中期選舉後恢復對伊朗大規模作戰（CCTV國際時訊）

【SEC深入調查古根海姆CEO馬克·沃爾特商業帝國，員工遭問詢】美國證券交易委員會（SEC）正就古根海姆合夥公司CEO馬克·沃爾特旗下業務潛在不當行為展開調查，已向管理3670億美元資產的古根海姆投資公司現任及前任員工發出問詢函，重點約談曾負責保險公司資產組合的人員。部分受訪員工已聘請律師應對。儘管古根海姆宣告“全力配合”，並稱會計處理“合理”、審計師認可，但調查範圍已從早期舉報人指控的私募部門收入費用披露問題，擴大至沃爾特旗下保險公司的關聯交易披露缺失——今年兩家保險子公司被曝超200億美元貸款未依規標記為關聯方交易，並已於6月收到曼哈頓聯邦檢察官傳票。

【四大AI程式設計代理曝相同安全漏洞，“技能”更新機制遭劫持風險】網路安全初創公司Air獨家披露，Anthropic Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini CLI及GitHub Copilot四款主流AI程式設計代理存在相同邏輯缺陷：其“技能”（Skills）自動更新機制未校驗內容變更，攻擊者可偽裝同名惡意更新繞過掃描，靜默竊取企業程式碼或智慧財產權。該漏洞源於各廠商驗證機制設計雷同，凸顯行業共性盲區。目前除GitHub外其餘三家已修復；GitHub稱平臺機制可阻斷此類攻擊，但未確認補丁狀態。

【勞合社更新黑海戰爭風險報告區，俄烏沿海水域仍須報備】倫敦保險市場勞合社市場協會（LMA）釋出宣告稱，聯合戰爭委員會（JWC）已擴大黑海報告區域名單，俄羅斯和烏克蘭沿海水域仍須納入報告範圍，而鄰近國家（如羅馬尼亞、保加利亞、土耳其）領海內的航行則無需報備。根據JWC規則，船東在進入列明區域前必須通知保險公司，否則出險可能遭拒賠。此次調整正值黑海航運風險持續升級之際——近期希臘管理油輪在俄羅斯海岸遭無人機襲擊後，黑海港口戰爭險保費已攀升至船舶價值的約1%，為2023年以來最高水平；保險報價有效期也從48小時縮短至24小時甚至即時更新。

【美國抵押貸款利率連續第四周上升 逼近7%】美國抵押貸款利率連續第四周上升，進一步逼近7%，在已經陷入停滯的美國住房市場，這一水平可能會讓借款人面臨更大壓力。房地美週四在宣告中表示，30年期固定利率抵押貸款平均利率從一週前的6.76%升至6.95%。這一水平為2025年1月以來最高。相比之下，一年前為6.26%。對於原本寄希望於2026年購房壓力能有所緩解的潛在購房者來說，抵押貸款利率逼近7%是令人沮喪。而且，美聯儲週三加息25個基點，這顯示借貸成本短期內可能難以回落。購房負擔不斷加重正成為即將到來的11月中期選舉的核心議題。儘管特朗普政府試圖透過購買債券和減少監管來支撐住房市場，但樓市迅速好轉的可能性正變得越來越低。“這根本是杯水車薪，而且已經太遲了，”Homes.com首席住宅經濟學家Brad Case表示，“選民不滿的是負擔能力問題，無論是購房者、租房者，還是每一個給汽車加油的人。”洲際交易所估計，要購買一套均價44萬美元的住宅，按揭付款將相當於家庭收入中位數的31%，為2025年7月以來最高。與此同時，住宅建築商信心本月跌至一年低點。

Lumber Falls to Nine-Month Low — Lumber futures fell below $550 per thousand board feet, reaching their lowest level in nine months, as elevated borrowing costs continued to weigh on demand. The US housing market remains tight, with mortgage rates near their highest level in over a year and showing no sign of easing after the Federal Reserve hiked its key policy rate, weighing on demand from prospective homebuyers. Building permits also fell 2.7% over the month, although a 7.6% increase in lumber-intensive single-family housing starts in August. Provided an offsetting pressure, US-Canada trade talks fell through, raising concerns over lumber supply. Ottawa had announced counter-tariffs of 25% on US lumber and 50% on plywood following US tariffs on several lumber-related goods. US forestry groups have long accused Canada of distorting the market, noting that 94% of Canadian forestland is publicly owned, compared with 58% privately owned in the US, allowing Canadian lumber to be sold at lower prices.

【奈及利亞翁多州疑似甲醇中毒事件死亡人數升至48人】奈及利亞翁多州政府17日稱，該州居民飲用當地釀造的酒精飲料後疑似中毒事件持續蔓延，死亡人數已升至48人。 翁多州政府稱，該州兩個社群9月初接連出現居民飲用當地釀造的酒精飲料後就醫的情況，10日已報告至少20人死亡。此後事件持續蔓延，截至目前，當地醫療機構已報告超過182例相關病例，其中48人死亡。 當地訊息人士稱，一名本地釀酒者將這種酒精飲料出售給當地居民，其中大多數為年輕人。 當地政府稱，受害者的尿液樣本檢測結果顯示，此次事件疑似與攝入甲醇中毒有關。截至目前，警方已逮捕15名涉嫌生產、銷售該酒精飲料的人員。 當地專家警告稱，甲醇是一種易燃且有毒的醇類物質，不可飲用，人體攝入後可能導致中樞神經系統抑制、永久性失明或死亡。(新華社)
